a: Denicha leh dela nistere avdeh.

Amar leh: hane mille hecha dela massek beh zuze. mar kevan demassek behu zuze michaze keribbit. deamar rav yosef bar minyome amar rav nachman: af al pi sheamru haddar bachatzar chavero shello middato eno tzarich lehaalot lo sachar. hilvahu vedar bachatzero tzarich lehaalot lo sachar. amar leh: hadari bi.

Amar abbaye: hay man demassek zuze deribbita bechavreh veka azli chitte arbea gerive bezuza beshuka, veyahev leh ihu chamsha, ki mappekinan minneh – arbea mappekinan minneh. iddach – ozole hu deka mozel gabbeh. rava amar: chamsha mappekinan minneh, demeikkara betorat ribbita atay lideh.

Veamar abbaye: hay man demassek arbea zuze deribbita bechavreh veyahev leh gelima begavvayyhu, ki mappekinan minneh – arbea mappekinan minneh, gelima la mappekinan minneh. rava amar: gelima mappekinan minneh. may tama, ki hechi dela lemru: gelima dimchasse vekae – gelima deribbita hu.
Amar rava: hay man demassek teresar zuze deribbita bechavreh veogar leh chatzer demittagra beasra veogray nihaleh bitresar, ki mappekinan minneh – teresar mappekinan minneh.
Amar leh rav acha middifti leravina: velema leh, ki (agra) [agari] hachi – dahava ka mishtarshi li, hasheta dela mishtarshi li – kidagri kulle alma hu deagarna, mishshum daamar leh: sevart vekabbelt.

Mishna marbin al hassachar veen marbin al hammecher. ketzad? hiskir lo et chatzero, veamar lo: "im meachshav atta noten li – hare hu lecha beeser selaim lashshana, veim shel chodesh bachodesh – sela lachodesh", muttar. machar lo et sadehu, veamar lo: "im meachshav atta noten li – hare hi shellecha beelef zuz, im laggoren – bishnem asar mane", asur.

Gemara may shena resha umay shena sefa? rabba verav yosef deamri tarvayyhu: sechirut enah mishtallemet ella bassof, vehay kevan dela meta zimneh lemigbe – lav agar netar leh, mishvo hu dehachi shavya, vehay dekaamar leh "im meachshav atta noten li hare hu lecha beeser selaim leshana" – ozole hu deka mozel gabbeh.

Sefa: kevan dizvine ninhu uvae lemishkal deme meachshav, hilkach agar netar leh hu, veasur. amar rava: daku ba rabbanan beha milleta veokmuha akkera: "kischir shana beshana", sechirut shel shana zo enah mishtallemet ella beshana acheret.
Veim laggoren bishnem asar mane – asur. amar rav nachman: tarsha shere.
Etiveh rame bar chama lerav nachman, veamri la rav ukeva bar chama lerav nachman: veim laggoren bishnem asar mane – asur! amar leh: hatam – katz leh, hacha – la katz leh.
Amar rav pappa: tarsha didi shere, may tama – shichray la pased, zuze la tzerichna, ana hu deka avedna milleta gabbe lokeach.

Amar leh rav sheshet bereh derav idi lerav pappa: may chaze mar deka azlat batar didach? zil batar didhu, deillu havo lehu zuze – havo shakli ki hasheta, hasheta delet lehu zuze – shakli keyukera dilkammeh!
Amar rav chama: tarsha didi vadday shere.
May tama – nicha lehu deleku birshuti, dechol hecha deka azli – shavki lehu michsa (unekut) [venakti] lehu shuka.
b: Vehilcheta kerav chama, vehilcheta kerabbi elazar, vehilcheta kerabbi yannay, deamar: ma li hen uma li demehen.

Mishna machar lo et hassade, venatan lo miktzat damim, veamar lo: ematay shettirtze have maot vetol et shellecha – asur. hilvahu al sadehu, veamar lo: im i atta noten li mikkan vead shalosh shanim – hare hi shelli, hare hi shello. vechach haya baytos ben zonin ose al pi chachamim.
Gemara mi ochel perot? rav huna amar: mocher ochel perot. rav anan amar: meshalleshin et happerot. vela peligi. ha deamar: lechi mayytet keni. ha deamar: lechi mayytet keni meachshav.
Tane rav safra beribbit deve rabbi chiyyay: peamim sheshshenehem muttarin, peamim sheshshenehem asurin, ufeamim shehammocher muttar velokeach asur, ufeamim shehallokeach muttar umocher asur.
Ane rava batreh: peamim sheshshenehem muttarin, deamar leh: keni keshiur zuzach. peamim sheshshenehem asurin, deamar leh: lechi mayytet keni meachshav.
Peamim mocher muttar velokeach asur, deamar leh: lechi mayytet keni. peamim shehallokeach muttar umocher asur, deamar leh: keni meachshav vezuzay lihvo halevaa gabbach.
Man tana shenehem asurin? amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua, dela kerabbi yehuda. dei rabbi yehuda, haamar: tzad echad beribbit – muttar.
Mishken lo bayit, mishken lo sade, veamar lo: "lichshettirtze lemochram – lo timkerem ella li baddamim hallalu" – asur. "beshovyehen" – muttar.
Man tanna "baddamim hallalu" asur? amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: dela kerabbi yehuda, dei rabbi yehuda, haamar: tzad echad beribbit – muttar.

Machar lo bayit, machar lo sade, veamar lo: "lichsheyyihyu li maot hachezirem li" – asur. "lichsheyyihyu lecha maot achazirem lach" – muttar. man tanna? amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: dela kerabbi yehuda. dei rabbi yehuda, haamar tzad echad beribbit – muttar.
May shena resha umay shena sefa? amar rava: resha – dela amar leh middateh. sefa – deamar leh middateh.
Hahu gavra dezabben leh ara lechavreh shello beachrayut, chazyeh dahava (ka) atziv. amar leh: ammay atzivat? i tarfu la minnach, magbena lach shufera, shevacha, ufere.
Amar ammemar:

a: Pattome mille bealma hu. amar leh rav ashe leammemar: tama may – kevan delokeach bae leatnoye, vehacha mocher ka matne, amrat pattome mille bealma hu.
Ella matnita dekatane: "lichsheyyihyu lecha maot achzir lach – muttar", democher hu devae leatnoye, mocher la atni velokeach ka matne.
Veamrinan: may shena resha umay shena sefa? veamar rava: sefa, daamar leh middateh. tama daamar leh middateh, ha la amar leh middateh – la amrinan pattome mille bealma hu.
Amar leh: naase keman daamar leh middateh ittemar.
Hahu shechiv mera, dichtav la gitta lidvethu, innegid veittenach. amara leh: ammay ka mittenachat? i kayymat – didach ana. amar rav zevid: pattome mille bealma hu.

Amar leh rav acha middifti leravina: vei lav pattome mille may? bedida kayyma lemishde tenaa begitta? bedideh kayyma lemishde tenaa! mahu detema: hu gufeh addata dida ka gamer veyahev gitta – ka mashma lan.
Hilvahu al sadehu, amar rav huna: bishat mattan maot – kana hakkol. leachar mattan maot – lo kana ella keneged meotav. verav nachman amar: afillu leachar mattan maot – kana hakkol.
Avad rav nachman ovada gabbe resh galuta kishmateh, kareh rav yehuda lishtareh. amar leh resh galuta: rav yehuda kera lishtarach. amar leh: dardeka kareh? gavra rabba kareh, chaza beh tama vekareh!
Ikka deamri, amar leh: dardeka kareh, dechulle alma legabbe didi bedina dardeke ninhu.
Hadar amar rav nachman: afillu bishat mattan maot – lo kana velo kelum. etiveh rava lerav nachman: im i atta noten li mikkan vead shalosh shanim, hare hi shelli – hare hi shello!
Amar leh: ani omer asmachta kanya. uminyome amar: asmachta la kanya.
Uleminyome kashya matnitin! ibbaet ema matnitin rabbi yose hi, deamar asmachta kanya.
b: Ibbaet ema: daamar leh keni meachshav.
Amaru leh mar yanoka umar kashshisha bene derav chisda lerav ashe, hachi amri nehardeae mishshemeh derav nachman: hay asmachta, bezimneh kanya, bela zimneh la kanya.
Amar lehu: kol midde, bezimneh kane, bela zimneh la kane.
Dilma hachi kaamritu: ashkecheh bego zimneh vaamar leh keni – kane, batar zimneh vaamar leh keni – la kane. may tama – mechamat kissufa hu dekaamar leh.
Vela hi, daafillu bego zimneh name la kane, vehay dekaamar leh "keni" – ka savar: ki mate zimneh, la layte litredan.
Amar rav pappa: hay asmachta, zimnin kanya vezimnin la kanya. ashkecheh deka shate shichra – kane. deka mehappech azzuze – la kane.
Amar leh rav acha middifti leravina: dilma lefakkoche pachdeh ka shate, i name: inish acharina asmecheh azzuze! ella amar ravina: i kafed bidme – vadday kane.
Amar leh rav acha middifti leravina: dilma savar ki hechi dela tittezil areh, ella amar rav pappa: i kafed beara, vadday kane.
Veamar rav pappa: af al gav daamur rabbanan asmachta la kanya, appoteke havya lemigbe minna.

Amar leh rav huna bereh derav natan lerav pappa: mi kaamar leh keni leguveyayna? amar leh mar zutera bereh derav mari leravina: vei amar keni lemigbe minneh – kane? sof sof asmachta hi, veasmachta la kanya.
Ella appoteke deamar rav pappa, may hi: daamar leh lo yehe lecha peraon ella mizzo.

Hahu gavra dezabben leh ara lechavreh beachrayut. amar leh: i tarfu lay minnay magbet li meidde iddit deit lach. amar leh: meidde iddit la magbena lach, devaena lemekam kammay, ella magbena lach meiddit achariti[10] deit li. lesof tarfuha minneh, ata bidka shekel leidde iddit.
Sevar rav pappa lememar: meiddit amar leh, veha kayyma.
Amar leh rav acha middifti leravina: velema leh, ki amari lach ana magbena lach – dahava idde iddit kayyma, hasheta kayyma leh iddit bimkom idde iddit.

Rav bar sheva hava massek beh rav kahana zuze. amar leh: i la parana lach leyom peloni – gevi mehay chamra. sevar rav pappa lememar: ki amrinan asmachta la kanya – hane mille beara, delav lezabbone kayyma. aval chamra kevan dilzabbone kae – kezuze dame.
Amar leh rav huna bereh derav yehoshua lerav pappa, hachi amrinan mishshemeh derabba: kol dei – la kane.
Amar rav nachman: hasheta daamur rabbanan asmachta la kanya, hadra ara vehadri pere. lememra desavar rav nachman mechila betaut la havya mechila?

Vehaittemar: hammocher perot dekel lachavero. amar rav huna: ad shello bau laolam – yachol lachzor bo. mishshebbau laolam – en yachol lachzor bo. verav nachman amar: af mishshebbau laolam yachol lachzor bo,
Veamar rav nachman: modena dei shamet veachel – la mappekinan minneh! hatam zevine, hacha halevaa.
Amar rava:

a: Hava yatevna kammeh derav nachman, uveay leotoveh onaa, veodek, chazitan ayylonit. vahare onaa dimchila betaut hi, vela havya mechila! veodek, chazitan ayylonit: hare ayylonit dimchila betaut hi, vehavya mechila.
Ditnan: hamemaenet vehashsheniyyay vehaayylonit, en lahen lo ketubba velo perot velo mezonot velo belaot.
Vela hi: la onaa havya teyuveteh, vela ayylonit mesayyay leh.
La onaa teyuveteh: dela yada deiteh onaa demachel gabbeh. vela ayylonit mesayyay leh, denicha la (detippok) [denippok] ala shema deishut.
Hahi itteta daamara leh lehahu gavra: zil zeven li ara mikkarivayy. azal zevan la. amar leh: i havu li zuze mahderat la nihali? amar leh: at venavvla ache.
Amar rabba bar rav huna: kol "at venavvla ache" (amar) samcha dateh, vela gamar umakne.
Ara hadra, pere may? ribbit ketzutza havu veyotzin bedayyaynin, o dilma ki avak ribbit havu veen yotzin?
Amar rabba bar rav huna: mistabbera ki avak ribbit havu, veen yotzin bedayyaynin. vechen amar rava: ki avak ribbit havu, veen yotzin bedayyaynin.
Amar leh abbaye lerabba: mashkanta, may? hatam tama may – mishshum dela katz leh, hacha name la katz leh. o dilma hatam zevine, hacha halevaa?
Amar leh: hatam tama may – mishshum dela katz leh, hacha name la katz leh.
Amar rav pappi: avad ravina ovada, vechashshev veappek pere, dela kerabba bar rav huna.
Amar mar bereh derav yosef mishshemeh derava: ha mashkanta beatra dimsalleki, achal shiur zuze – mesallekinan leh.
Achal tefe – la mappekinan minneh, vela mechashshevinan mishshetara lishtara.
Uvidyatme achal shiur zuze, mesallekinan leh. achal tefe – mappekinan minneh, umechashshevinan mishshetara lishtara.

Amar rav ashe: hasheta deamrat achal tefe – la mappekinan minneh. achal shiur zuze name – la mesallekinan leh bela zuze, may tama: salloke bela zuze – appoke minneh hu. have avak ribbit, vaavak ribbit enah yotza bedayyaynin.
Avad rav ashe ovada bitomim ketannim
b: Kigdolim,
Amar rava bereh derav yosef mishshemeh derava: hay mashkanta, beatra dimsalleki – la nechol ella benachyeyta. vetzureba midderabbanan – afillu benachyeyta la nechol. ella bemay nechol? bekitztzuta.

Hanicha leman deamar kitztzuta sharya, ella leman deamar kitztzuta asira, may ikka lememar? deittemar: kitztzuta, peliga ba rav acha veravina. chad amar: kitztzuta sharya, vechad amar: kitztzuta asira. hechi dame kitztzuta? deamar leh: ad chamesh shenin achelna la bela nachyeyta, mikkan veelach shayemna lach kullehu pere.
Ikka deamri: kol bela nachyeyta – asur, aval hechi dame kitztzuta – deamar leh: ad chamesh shenin achelna benachyeyta, mikkan veelach shayemna lach kullehu pere.
Man deasar bekammayyta share bevatrayyta, man deasar bevatrayyta, hechi shere lemechal? shere ki mashkanta desura, dechatvi ba hachi: bemishlam shenayya illen tippok ara da bela kesaf.
Rav pappa verav huna bereh derav yehoshua amri tarvayyhu: hay mashkanta, beatra dimsalleki – en baal chov gove hemenna, veen habbechor notel bah pi shenayim, usheviit meshammattah.
Uveatra dela mesalleki – baal chov gove hemenna uvechor notel bah pi shenayim, veen sheviit meshammattah.

Veamar mar zutera mishshemeh derav pappa: hay mashkanta, beatra dimsalleki – mesalleki leh vaafillu mittamre deabbudeya. vei agbehinhu besisane, kenanhu. uleman deamar kilyo shel lokeach birshut mocher kana lokeach – afillu dela agbehinhu besisane, kenanhu.
Peshita: beatra dimsalleki veamar "la mistallakna" – ha kaamar dela mistallakna. ella beatra dela mesalleki, veamar "mistallakna" – may: tzarich lemikne minneh, o la?
Rav pappa amar: la tzerich lemikne minneh. rav sheshet bereh derav idi amar: tzerich lemikne minneh. vehilcheta: tzerich lemikne minneh.
Amar: "ezil veayyte zuze" – la achel. "ezil veetrach veayyte zuze", ravina amar: achel, umar zutera bereh derav mari amar: la achel. vehilcheta: la achel.
Rav kahana verav pappa verav ashe la achli benachyeyta. ravina achel benachyeyta.
Amar mar zutera: may tama deman deachel benachyeyta – midde dehave assede achuzza. sede achuzza, lav af al gav deka achel pere tuva, amar rachamana

a: Ka farek la bearbea zuze, hacha name la shena.
Uman deasar – amar lach: sede achuzza hekdesh hi, verachamana okmeh appidyon. hacha – halevaa hi umichaze keribbit.
Amar rav ashe: amaru li save demata machseya: setam mashkanta – shatta. lemay nafka minna? dei achel la shatta – matze mesallek leh, vei la – la matze mesallek leh.
Veamar rav ashe: amaru li save demata machseya, may "mashkanta" – dishchuna gabbeh. lemay nafka minna? ledina devar mitzra.
Amar rava: let hilcheta la ketarshe pappunae, vela kishtare machoznae, vela kachachire narshae.
Ketarshe pappunae – ketarshe derav pappa.
Shetare machoznae – dezakfi leh leravvcha akkarna, vechatvi leh bishtara. mi yemar dehave ravvcha?

Amar leh mar bar ammemar lerav ashe: abba aved hachi, vechi atu lekammeh meheman lehu. amar leh: tinach hecha deiteh ledideh, i shachev venafel shetara kamme yatme, may? have "kishgaga sheyyotza millifne hashshallit" venach nafsheh deammemar.
Chachire narshae, dechatvi hachi: mishken leh pelanya areh liflanya, vahadar chachra minneh. emat kenaah deakneyay nihaleh?
Vehaiddana deka chatvi hachi: "kenena minneh ushehena kamma iddane, vahadar chachra", kede shello tinol delet bifne lovin – shappir dame. velav milleta hi.
Mishna en moshivin chenvani lemachatzit sachar, velo yitten maot likkach bahen perot lemachatzit sachar, ella im ken noten lo secharo kefoel.
En moshivin tarnegolin lemechetza, veen shamin agalin useyaychin lemechetza, ella im ken noten lo sechar amalo umezono.
Aval mekabbelin agalin useyaychin lemechetza, umegaddelin otan ad sheyyehu meshullashin. vachamor ad shettehe toenet.
Gemara tana: kefoel batel. may kefoel batel?
b: Amar abbaye: kefoel batel shel otah melacha divtal minna.
Utzericha, dei tena chenvani: chenvani hu desaggi leh kefoel batel, mishshum dela nefish tircheh. aval maot likkach bahen perot, dinfish tircheh – ema la saggi leh kefoel batel.

Vei tena maot likkach bahen perot – hava amena: hatam hu devae kefoel batel, mishshum dinfish tircheh. aval chenvani, dela nefish tircheh – ema saggi leh bemashshehu bealma, daafillu lo tibbel immo ella betzir, velo achal immo ella gerogeret achat – zehu secharo, tzericha.
(Kamma izze vetarnegolin maalin siman)

Tanu rabbanan: kamma hu secharo? ben merubbe uven muat, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: afillu lo tibbel immo ella betzir, velo achal immo ella gerogeret achat – zehu secharo. rabbi shimon ben yochay omer: noten lo secharo meshallem.
Tanu rabbanan: en shamin lo et haizzim velo et harchelim, velo kol davar sheeno ose veochel lemechetza.
Rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer: shamin et haizzim mippene shecholvot, veet harchelim mippene sheggozzot veshotfot umortot, veet hattarnegolet mippene shehi osa veochelet.
Vetanna kamma: gizza vechalav la safek sechar amalo umezono? begizza vechalav – kulle alma la peligi, ki feligi benasyove vetutere.

Tanna kamma savar la kerabbi shimon ben yochay, deamar: noten lo secharo mishshalem. rabbi yose berabbi yehuda savar la kaavu, deamar: afillu lo tibbel immo ella betzir, velo achal immo ella gerogeret achat – zehu secharo.

Tanu rabbanan: maskeret ishsha lachavertah tarnegolet bishne efrochin. ishsha sheamra lachavertah: "tarnegolet shelli uvetzim shellichi, vaani veat nachlok baefrochin" – rabbi yehuda mattir, rabbi shimon oser.
Verabbi yehuda la bae sechar amalo umezono? ikka betzim muzarot.

Tanu rabbanan: makom shennahagu lehaalot sechar kattaf lemaot livhema – maalin, veen meshannin mimminhag hammedina. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: shamin egel im immo, useyach im immo, vaafillu bimkom shennahagu lehaalot sechar kattaf lemaot.
Verabban shimon ben gamliel la bae sechar amalo umezono? ikka gelalim. veiddach: gelalim – afkore mafker lehu.
Amar rav nachman: halacha kerabbi yehuda, vahalacha kerabbi yose berabbi yehuda, vahalacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel.

Bene rav ilish nefak alayyhu hahu shetara dahava ketiv beh "palga baagar, palga behefsed". amar rava: rav ilish gavra rabba hu, veissura leinashe la have safe. ma nafshach? i palga baagar – tere tilte behefsed,

a: I palga behefsed – tere tilte baagar.

Amar rav kahana: amrita lishmata kammeh derav zevid minnehardea, vaamar li: dilma rav ilish tovel immo betzir hava. veamar rav nachman: halacha kerabbi yehuda! amar leh: lav hilcheta ittemar, ella shita ittemar.
Hachi name mistabbera, dei la tema hachi – lema leh lemichshav ulememar halacha halacha? lema halacha kerabbi yehuda, demekel mikkullehu.
Amar rav: motar shelish bischarcha – hare ze muttar. ushemuel amar: lo matza motar shelish, yelech leveto rekan! ella amar shemuel: kotzetz lo dinar.
Vesavar rav en kotztzin lo dinar? vehaamar rav: resh igla lefatoma, may lav deamar leh: motar shelish bischarcha?
Lo, dekaamar leh: i motar shelish, i resh igla lefatoma. ibbaet ema: ki kaamar rav motar shelish bischarcha muttar – kegon deit leh behema ledideh. deamri inashe: gabbel letora, gabbel letore.

Rabbi elazar mehageronya zaven behema, veyahev leh laariseh mefattem leh, veyahev leh resha beagreh, veyahev palga ravvcha. amara leh devethu: i mishtattefat bahadeh yahev lach name alyeta. azal zaven bahadeh, peleg leh mealyeta. amar leh: ta niflegeh leresha. amar leh: hasheta kemeikkara name la?

Amar leh: ad haiddana zuze didi havo, i la hava yahevna lach tefe pureta – michaze keribbit, hasheta shuttafe anan, may kaamrat tarachna tefe pureta, amri inashe: setam arisa lemare ara kamshabed nafsheh leetoye leh riya.

Tanu rabbanan: hashsham behema lachavero, ad matay chayyayv littappel bah? somchos omer: baatonot shemona asar chodesh, begodrot esrim vearbaa chodesh. veim ba lachalok betoch zemanno – chavero meakkev alav, aval eno dome tippulah shel shana zo letippulah shel shana acheret.
"Aval" may kaamar? ella: lefi sheeno dome tippulah shel shana zo letippulah shel shana acheret.

Tanya iddach: hashsham behema lachavero, ad matay chayyayv littappel bavveladot? baddakka – sheloshim yom, uvaggassa – chamishshim yom. rabbi yose omer: baddakka shelosha chodashim, mippene shettippulah merubbe. may tippulah merubbe – mippene sheshshinneha dakkot. mikkan veelach notel mechetza shello, vachatzi mechetza beshel chavero.

Rav menashsheya bar gadda shekal mechetza shello vachatzi mechetza beshel chavero. ata lekammeh deabbaye. amar leh: man pelag lach? veod: makom shennahagu legaddel hu, utenan: makom shennahagu legaddel – yegaddelu.
Hanhu tere kutae daavud iska bahade hadade. azal chad minnayyhu pelayg zuze bela dateh dechavreh. ato lekammeh derav pappa. amar leh: may nafka minna? hachi amar rav nachman: zuze keman difligi damu.
Leshana zevun chamra bahade hadade. kam iddach pelayg leh bela dateh dechavreh, ato lekammeh derav pappa. amar leh: man pelag lach? amar leh: ka chazena devatar didi ka ate mar! amar rav pappa:
b: Kehay gavna vadday tzerich leodoeh: zuze, mi shakel tave veshavek chassire?
Amar leh: la. amar leh: chamra, kulle alma yadi deikka divsim veikka dela besim.
Gufa, amar rav nachman: zuze, keman difligi damu. hane mille tave vetave, tekule utekule. aval tave utekule – la.
Rav chama hava mogar zuze bifshita beyoma. kelo zuze derav chama. hu savar: may shena mimmara? vela hi mara hadra baena vidia pechateh, zuze la hadri beenayyhu vela yedia pechateh.

Amar rava: shere leh leinish lememar leh lechavreh: helach arbea zuze veozfeh liflanya zuze, lo asra tora ella ribbit habbaa millove lemalve. veamar rava: shere leh leinish lememar leh lechavreh "shekol lach arbea zuze veemor leh lifloni leozofan zuze". may tama – sechar amira ka shakel.

Ki ha deabba mar bereh derav pappa hava shakel ugena dekira mikkirae, vaamar leh laavu: ozfinhu zuze. amaru leh rabbanan lerav pappa: achel bereh demar ribbita! amar lehu: kol ki hay ribbita nechol, lo asra tora ella ribbit habbaa millove lemalve. hacha – sechar amira ka shakel, ushere.
Mishna shamin para vachamor vechol davar shehu ose veochel lemechetza. makom shennahagu lachlok et havveladot miyyad – cholkin. makom shennahagu legaddel – yegaddelu.
Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: shamin egel im immo, useyach im immo, umafriz al sadehu, veeno choshesh mishshum ribbit.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: mafriz al sadehu veeno choshesh mishshum ribbit, ketzad? hassocher et hassade mechavero baasara korim chittin leshana, veomer lo: ten li matayim zuz vaafarnesenna, vaani aale lecha shenem asar korin leshana – muttar.
Aval en mafriz lo al chanut velo al sefina.

Amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: peamim shemmafriz al chanut latzor bah tzura, sefina laasot lah iskarya. chanut latzor bah tzureta: detzavu ba inashe vehave agra tefe. sefina laasot lah iskarya: kevan deshappira iskarya tefe – agra tefe.
Sefinta, amar rav: agra ufagra. amaru leh rav kahana verav assi lerav: i agra – la pagra, i pagra – la agra. shetek rav.

Amar rav sheshet: may tama shetek rav? la shemia leh ha detanya: af al pi sheamru en mekabbelin tzon barzel miyyisrael, aval mekabbelin tzon barzel min haggoyim. aval amru: hashsham para lachavero, veamar lo: hare paratcha asuya alay bishloshim dinar, vaani aale lecha sela bechodesh – muttar, lefi shello asaah damim.
Velo asaah?! amar rav sheshet: lo asaah damim mechayyim, ella leachar mita.
Amar rav pappa, hilcheta: sefina agra ufagra.

a: Venahagu bene chufera agra bishat meshicha, pagra bishat shevira. attu beminhaga talya milleta? mishshum dematnita tanya – minhaga.

Amar rav anan amar shemuel: maot shel yetomim muttar lehalevotan beribbit. amar leh rav nachman: mishshum deyatme ninhu (safena) [safenan] lehu issura?! yatme deachli delav didhu lezlu batar shavkayyhu! amar leh: ema li izi gufa deovada hechi hava?
Amar leh: hahu duda divne mar ukeva dahava be mar shemuel, takel veyahev leh, takel veshakel leh. shakel agra veshakel pachata. i agra – la pachata, vei pachata – la agra.
Amar leh: ki ha – afillu bediknane name shere lemibad, deha mekabbeli alayyhu chusecha dinchasha, dechamma demikkele nechasha betzir demeh.
Amar rabba bar shela amar rav chisda, veamri la, amar rabba bar yosef bar chama amar rav sheshet: maot shel yetomim muttar lehalevotan karov lesachar verachok lehefsed.
Tanu rabbanan: karov lesachar verachok lehefsed – rasha. karov lehefsed verachok lesachar – chasid. karov laze velaze, rachok mizze umizze – zo hi middat kol adam.
Amar leh rabba lerav yosef: hane zuze deyatme hechi avdinan lehu? amar leh: motvinan lehu be dina veyahavinan lehu zuza zuza. amar leh: veha ka chalya karna.

Amar leh mar: hechi aved? amar leh: badkinan gavra deit leh dahava pericha, venaktinan dahava minneh, veyahavinan lehu nihaleh karov lesachar verachok lehefsed. aval davar mesuyyam – la, dilma pikkadon ninhu, veate mareh yahev simanin veshakel leh.

Amar rav ashe: tinach i mishtechach gavra deit leh dahava pericha, i la mishtechach gavra deit leh dahava pericha nechlu zuze deyatme? ella amar rav ashe: chazenan gavra dimshappu nichseh, umeheman, veshama dina deorayyta vela mekabbel shamta derabbanan, veyahavinan lehu nihaleh beve dina.
b: Mishna en mekabbelin tzon barzel miyyisrael – mippene shehu ribbit. aval mekabbelin tzon barzel min haggoyim,
Velovin mehen umalvin otan beribbit. vechen beger toshav. malve yisrael meotav shel nochri – middaat hannochri, aval lo middaat yisrael.
Gemara lememra devirshuta dimkabbel kayyma? ureminhu: hamekabbel tzon barzel min haggoyim – veladot peturin min habbechora!
Amar abbaye, la kashya: ha dimkabbel aleh unesa vezola, ha dela kabbel aleh unesa vezola.
Amar leh rava: i dekabbel aleh mara unesa vezola – tzon barzel karet leh?
Veod addetane sefa: aval mekabbelin tzon barzel min haggoyim liflog bedideh: bamme devarim amurim – dela kabbel aleh unesa vezola, aval kabbel mara unesa vezola – shappir dame!

Ella amar rava: idde veidde dela kabbel aleh mara unesa vezola, vegabbe bechorot hayeynu taam divladot peturin min habbechora: kevan dei la yahev zuze, ate goy tafes la livhema. vei la mashkach la livhema, tafes lehu livladot, vehave lay yad goy baemtza.
Vechol yad goy baemtza – patur min habbechora.
"Marbe hono beneshech vetarbit lechonen dallim yikbetzennu". may lechonen dallim? amar rav: kegon shabbur malka.
Amar rav nachman, amar li huna: lo nitzrecha ella daafillu ribbit degoy. etiveh rava lerav nachman: "lannochri tashshich", may tashshich – lav tishshoch? la, tashshich.
La saggi delav hachi? leappoke achicha dela.
Achicha behedya ketiv beh: "uleachich lo tashshich"! laavor alav baase velo taase.
Etiveh: lovin mehen umalvin otam beribbit, vechen beger toshav! amar rav chiyyay bereh derav huna: lo nitzrecha ella

a: Bichde chayyav.
Ravina amar: hacha betalmide chachamim askinan. tama may gezur rabbanan – shemma yilmod mimmaasav, vechevan detalmid chacham hu – lo yilmod mimmaasav.

Ikka dematne la leha derav huna aha detane rav yosef: "im kesef talve et ammi et heani immach". ammi vegoy – ammi kodem, ani veashir – ani kodem. "aniyyecha vaaniyye irecha" – aniyyecha kodmin, aniyye irecha vaaniyye ir acheret – aniyye irecha kodmin.
Amar mar: ammi vegoy ammi kodem, peshita! amar rav nachman amar li huna: la nitzrecha, daafillu legoy beribbit uleyisrael bechinnam.

Tanya, amar rabbi yose: bo uree samyut enehem shel malve beribbit. adam kore lachavero "rasha" – yored immo lechayyav. vehem meviin edim velavlar vekulemos udeyo, vechotvin vechotmin: peloni ze kafar belohe yisrael.

Tanya, rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: kol mi sheyyesh lo maot umalve otam shello beribbit, alav hakkatuv omer "kaspo lo natan beneshech veshochad al naki lo lakach ose elle lo yimmot leolam". ha lamadta shekkol hammalve beribbit nechasav mitmottin. veha ka chazenan dela mozfi beribbit veka mitmottin! amar rabbi elazar: hallalu mitmottin veolin, vehallalu mitmottin veenan olin.
"Lamma tabbit bogdim tacharish kevalla rasha tzaddik mimmennu". amar rav huna: tzaddik mimmennu – bolea, tzaddik gamur – eno bolea.
Tanya, rabbi omer: ger tzedek haamur leinyan mechira, veger toshav haamur leinyan ribbit, eni yodea ma hu.
Ger tzedek haamur leinyan mechira, dichtiv: "vechi yamuch achicha immach venimkar lach". velo lecha, ella leger, shenneemar: "leger".
Velo leger tzedek ella leger toshav, shenneemar: "leger toshav". "mishpachat ger" – ze haggoy. keshehu omer "o leeker" – ze hannimkar laavoda zara atzmah.
Amar mar: velo lecha ella leger, shenneemar: "leger", lememra deger kane eved ivri? vrminhi: en hagger nikne beeved ivri, veen ishsha veger konin eved ivri.
Ger lo nikne beeved ivri: "veshav el mishpachto" baenan, veha lekka. veen ishsha veger konin eved ivri: ishsha – lav orach ara. ger name gemiri: demikkene – kane, dela mikkene – la kane.
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: eno kone vedino keyisrael, aval kone vedino kegoy.
Detanya: hannirtza vehannimkar legoy eno oved lo et habben velo et habbat.

Amar mar: veen ishsha veger konin eved ivri. nema dela kerabban shimon ben gamliel? detanya: ishsha kona et hashshefachot, veenah kona et haavadim. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: af kona et haavadim! afillu tema rabban shimon ben gamliel, vela kashya: kan – beeved ivri, kan – beeved kenaani.
Eved ivri tzenia la, eved kenaani peritz la.

Ella ha detane rav yosef: armalta la terabbe kalba, vela tashre bar be rav beushepiza. bishlama bar be rav tzenia la, ella kalba, kevan dimsarech ba miratteta! amri: kevan dechi shadya leh umetza mesarech batra, amri inashe: mishshum umetza deshadya leh hu dimsarech.

Ger toshav haamur leinyan ribbit may hi, dichtiv: "vechi yamuch achicha umata yado immach vehechezakta bo ger vetoshav vachay immach. al tikkach meitto neshech vetarbit veyareta meelohecha veche achicha immach". ureminhi: lovin mehen umalvin otan beribbit, vechen beger toshav!
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: mi ketiv "al tikkach meittam"? "meitto" ketiv, miyyisrael.
Tanu rabbanan: "al tikkach meitto neshech vetarbit" – aval atta naase lo arev.
b: Arev leman? ilema arev leyisrael, veha tana: ellu ovrin belo taase hammalve vehallove, hearev vehaedim!
Ella legoy vechevan dedineh degoy deazel batar arva, ihu nihu deka shakel minneh ribbita!
Amar rav sheshet: shekkibbel alav ladun bedine yisrael. i kibbel alav ladun bedine yisrael – ribbit name la lishkol! amar rav sheshet: shekkibbel alav lazo, velo kibbel alav lazo.

Malve yisrael meotav shel nochri middaat hannochri kulei. tanu rabbanan: malve yisrael meotav shel nochri middaat hannochri, aval lo middaat yisrael, ketzad? yisrael shellava maot min haggoy beribbit uvikkesh lehacheziram lo, metzao yisrael acher veamar lo: tenem li vaani aale lach kederech sheatta maale lo – asur. veim heemidu etzel goy – muttar.
Vechen goy shellava maot miyyisrael beribbit uvikkesh lehacheziram lo, metzao yisrael acher veamar lo: tenem li vaani aale lecha kederech sheatta maale lo – muttar. veim heemido etzel yisrael – asur.
Bishlama sefa, lechumera. ella resha: kevan deen shelichut legoy, ihu nihu deka shakel minneh ribbita?
Amar rav huna bar manoach mishshemeh derav acha bereh derav ika: hacha bemay askinan – kegon daamar leh: hannichem al gabbe karka vehippater. i hachi, may lememra?
Ella amar rav pappa: kegon shennatal venatan bayyad. veakkatti, may lememra?! mahu detema: goy gufeh ki aved – addata deyisrael ka gamer veyahev, ka mashma lan.
Rav ashe amar: ki amrinan en shelichut legoy – hane mille bitruma, aval bechol hattora kullah – yesh shelichut legoy.
Veha derav ashe beruta hi: may shena teruma dela, dichtiv "attem" – "gam attem": ma attem bene berit – af sheluchachem name bene berit.
Shelichut dechol hattora kullah name mitteruma gamrinan la. ella derav ashe beruta hi.

Ikka deamri, amar rav ashe: ki amrinan en shelichut legoy hane mille inhu ledidan, aval anan ledidhu havena lehu sheliach. veha derav ashe beruta hi, may shena inhu ledidan dela – dichtiv: "attem" "gam attem" – lerabbot sheluchachem: ma attem bene verit – af sheluchachem bene verit.
Anan ledidhu name, ma attem bene verit kaamar! ella ha derav ashe beruta hi.
Ravina amar: nehi dishlichut legoy let leh, zechiyya midderabbanan it leh, midde dehave akkatan. katan lav af al gav delet leh shelichut,

a: It leh zechiyya midderabbanan. hacha name la shena.
Vela hi: yisrael ate lichlal shelichut, nochri la ate lichlal shelichut.

Tanu rabbanan: yisrael shellava maot min hannochri beribbit, uzekafan alav bemilve, venitgayyer. im kodem shennitgayyer zekafan alav bemilve – gove et hakkeren vegove et haribbit. veim leachar shennitgayyer zekafan alav bemilve – gove et hakkeren veeno gove et haribbit.

Vechen nochri shellava maot miyyisrael beribbit uzekafan alav bemilve venitgayyer, im ad shello nitgayyer zekafan alav bemilve – gove et hakkeren vegove et haribbit. im mishshennitgayyer zekafan alav bemilve – gove et hakkeren veeno gove et haribbit.

Rabbi yose omer: nochri shellava maot miyyisrael beribbit, ben kach uven kach – gove et hakkeren vegove et haribbit. amar rava amar rav chisda amar rav huna: halacha kerabbi yose. amar rava: may tama derabbi yose – kede shello yomru bishvil meotav nitgayyer ze.

Tanu rabbanan: shetar shekkatuv bo ribbit – konsin oto, veeno gove lo et hakkeren velo et haribbit, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: gove et hakkeren veeno gove et haribbit. bemay kamippalgi? rabbi meir savar: kansinan hettera mishshum issura, verabbanan savri: la kansinan hettera mishshum issura.
Tenan hatam: shetare chov hammukedamin – pesulin, vehameucharin – kesherin. mukedamin ammay pesulin? nehi dela gevo mizzeman rishon, nigbo mizzeman sheni!
Amar rabbi shimon ben lakish: bemachloket shenuya, verabbi meir hi. verabbi yochanan amar: afillu tema rabbanan – gezera shemma yigbe mizzeman rishon.
Hahu gavra demashken leh pardesa lechavreh, achla telat shene. amar leh: i mezabbeynat la nihali – mutav, vei la – kaveshna la lishtar mashkanta veamena: "lekucha hi beyadi".
Azal kam akneyay livno katan, vahadar zabbena nihaleh.

Zevine vadday la havu zevine. zuze kemilve bishtar damu vegove minnechasim meshuebadim, o dilma kemilve al pe damu veeno gove minnechasim meshuebadim? amar abbaye: velav hayeynu derabbi assi, deamar rabbi assi:
b: Mode bishtar shekketavo – eno tzarich lekayyeymo, vegove minnechasim meshuebadim.
Amar leh rava: mi dame? hatam nittan lehikkatev. hacha lo nittan lehikkatev.

Yatev marimar vekaamar leha shemata. amar leh ravina lemarimar: ella ha deamar rabbi yochanan gezera shemma yigbe mizzeman rishon, nema: lo nittan likkatev! amar leh hachi hasheta. hatam nehi delo nittan likkatev mizzeman rishon, aval nittan likkatev mizzeman sheni. hacha lo nittan likkatev kelal.

Ella ha detanya: leshevach karkaot ketzad? hare sheggazal sade mechavero umecharah leacher vehishbichah, vahare hi yotza mittachat yado. keshehu gove – gove et hakkeren minnechasim meshuebadim, veshevach gove minnechasim bene chorin. nema: lo nittan likkatev!

Hachi hasheta? hatam, i leman deamar nicha leh dela nikreyeh gazlana, i leman deamar nicha leh delekum behemanuteh, mefayyes leh lemareh umokem leh lishtareh. hacha, leavroche minneh kamchavven, shetara mekayyem leh.
Mishna en poskin al happerot ad sheyyetze hashshaar. yatza hashshaar – poskin, veaf al pi sheen laze yesh laze.
Haya hu techilla lakkotzrim, posek immo al haggadish, veal heavit shel anavim, veal hammaatan shel zetim, veal habbetzim shel yotzer, veal hassid mishsheshshikkeo bakkivshan.
Ufosek immo al hazzevel kol yemot hashshana. rabbi yose omer: en poskin al hazzevel ella im ken hayta lo zevel baashpa, vachachamim mattirim.
Ufosek immo beshaar haggavoah. rabbi yehuda omer: af al pi shello pasak immo beshaar haggavoah, yachol lomar: ten li kaze, o ten li et meotay.

Gemara amar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan: en poskin al hashshaar shebbashshuk. amar leh rabbi zera lerabbi assi: amar rabbi yochanan afillu kaddormus hazze? amar leh: la amar rabbi yochanan ella bashshuk shel ayayrot, dela kevii tarayyhu.

Uleman dislek addatin meikkara deamar rabbi yochanan afillu kaddormus hazze, ella matnitin dekatane: en poskin al happerot ad sheyyetze hashshaar, yatza hashshaar poskin, hechi mashkachat la? matnitin bechitte deachlabbe vearve, dimshivch tarayhu tefe.

Tanu rabbanan: en poskin al happerot ad sheyyetze hashshaar, yatza hashshaar poskin, af al pi sheen laze yesh laze. hayu chadashot mearba vishanot mishshalosh – en poskin ad sheyyetze hashshaar lechadash velayyashan.
Hayu lakotot mearba, ulechol adam mishshalosh – en poskin ad sheyyetze hashshaar lalloket velammocher.

Amar rav nachman: poskin lallakotot keshaar hallakotot. amar leh rava lerav nachman: may shena lakot dei let leh yazef millakot chavreh, baal habbayit name yezef millakot! amar leh: baal habbayit zila beh milleta lemezaf millakot. ibbaet ema: man deyahev zuze levaal habbayit – appere shappire yahev.

Amar rav sheshet amar rav huna: en lovin al shaar shebbashshuk. amar leh rav yosef bar chama lerav sheshet, veamri la rav yose bar abba lerav sheshet: umi amar rav huna hachi? veha bae minneh merav huna: hane bene be rav, deyazfi betishri ufari betevet, shere o asir? amar lehu: ha chitte behine veha chitte beshile, i bae zavni ufari leh.
Meikkara savar rav huna en lovin, kevan deshama leha deamar rabbi shemuel bar chiyyay amar rabbi elazar: lovin, amar ihu name: lovin.
Tanu rabbanan: hammolich chavila mimmakom lemakom, metzao chavero veamar lo: tenah li vaani aale lecha kederech shemmaalin lecha beoto makom.

a: Birshut mocher – muttar, birshut lokeach – asur.

Hammolich perot mimmakom lemakom, metzao chavero veamar lo: tenem li vaani aale lecha perot sheyyesh li beoto makom, im yesh lo perot beoto makom – muttar, veim lav – asur. vehachammarin maalim bimkom hayyoker kevimkom hazzol, veenan choshshin.
May tama? rav pappa amar: nicha lehu dimgallu lehu tara. rav acha bereh derav ika amar: nicha lehu demozli gabbayyhu.
May benayyhu? ikka benayyhu taggara chadta.
Besura azli arbaa arbea, bechafri azlan shitta shitta. yahev rav zuze lechammare u[m]kabbel aleh unesa deorcha, veshakel minnayyhu chamsha. venishkol shitta! adam chashuv shane.

Bea minneh rabbi assi merabbi yochanan: mahu laasot bigrutaot ken? amar leh: bikkesh rabbi yishmael berabbi yose laasot ken bichle fishtan, velo hinnicho rabbi. ikka deamri: bikkesh rabbi laasot bigrutaot ken, velo hinnicho rabbi yishmael berabbi yose.
Pardesa, rav asar ushemuel share. rav asar, kevan dilkammeh shavya tefe – mitchaze ki agar netar leh. ushemuel share, kevan dehave beh tivha – la michaze ki agar netar leh.
Amar rav shimi bar chiyyay: umode rav betore dinfish pesedayyhu.
Amar lehu shemuel lehanhu deshavshi shivsha, hafochu beara, ki hechi dikne lechu gufa deara, vei la – havya lechu kehalevaa veasur.

Amar lehu rava lehanhu dimnatteri bage: puku hafochu beve dare, ki hechi dela tishtallam sechirut didchu ad hahi shata, dischirut enah mishtallemet ella bassof, vehahi shata ozole deka mozli gabbayychu.
Amaru leh rabbanan lerava: ka achel mar ribbit, dechulle alma shakli arbea umesalleki learisa benisan, mar natar lehu ad iyyayr veshakel shitta!
Amar lehu: attun ka avditun shello kaddin, ara learis mishtabad – i attun mesallekitu lehu benisan, mafsedtu lehu bechamma. ana natarna lehu ad iyyayr, umarvavchna lehu bechamma.
b: Rav mari bar rachel mashken leh hahu goy beta. hadar zabbene lerava. netar teresar yarche shatta, shekal agar beta amti leh lerava. amar leh: hay dela amtay lemar agar beta ad haiddana, distam mashkanta shatta, i bae goy lesalloke la hava matze mesallek li, hasheta lishkol mar agar beta.

Amar leh: i hava yadana dahava memushekan leh lemar, la hava zavenna leh. hasheta kedinehem avedna lach, kol emat dela mesalleki bezuze la shakel agar beta. ana name la shakelna minnach agar beta ad dimsallekna lach bezuze.
Amar leh rava mibbarnish lerav ashe: chazi mar rabbanan deka achli ribbita, deyahavi zuze achamra betishri umevachari le betevet!
Amar leh: inhu name achamra ka yahavi, achalla la ka yahavi – meikkara dechamra chamra, dechalla challa, hahi shata hu dekamvachari.
Ravina hava yahev zuze livne akra deshanvota veshafchi leh tefe kufita. ata lekammeh derav ashe, amar leh: mi shere? amar leh: in, achole hu deka machali gabbach.
Amar leh: ha ara lav didhu hi! amar leh: ara letaska meshabeda. umalka amar: man deyahev taska – lechol ara.

Amar leh rav pappa lerava: chazi mar hane rabbanan deyahavi zuze akkeraga deinashe umeshabedi behu tefe! amar leh: hasheta ikko shechevi la amari lechu ha milleta. hachi amar rav sheshet: muherkayyhu dehane betufsa demalka mannach, umalka amar: man dela yahev keraga lishtabayd leman deyahev keraga!

Rav seuram achu derava hava takef inashe dela meallu umeayyel lehu beguharka derava. amar leh rava: shappir ka avdat, ditnena: reit[vo] sheeno noheg kashshura, minnayin sheatta rashshay lehishtabed bo – talmud lomar: "leolam bahem taavodu uveachechem". yachol afillu noheg kashshura – talmud lomar: "uveachechem bene yisrael ish beachiv vegomer".
Amar rav chama: hay man deyahev zuze lechavreh lemizban leh chamra ufesha vela zevayn leh – meshallem leh kidka azel apparvota dezuleshfat.
Amar ammemar amrita lishmata kammeh derav zevid minnehardea, amar: ki kaamar rav chama, hane mille beyayin" setam, aval beyayin ze" – la, mi yemar dimzabbeni leh nihaleh?
Rav ashe amar: afillu "yayin" setam name la, may tama – asmachta hi, veasmachta la kanya.
Ulerav ashe may shena meha ditnan: "im over vela eeved ashallem bemetva", hatam beyado,

a: Hacha lav beyado.

Amar rava: hane be telata deyahavi zuze lechad lemizban lehu midde uzevan lechad minnayyhu – zevan lechullehu. vela amaran ella dela tzar vachatem inish inish lechodeh. aval tzar vachatem inish inish lechodeh, leman dizvan – zevan, uleman dela zevan – la zevan.
Amar rav pappi mishshemeh derava: hay situmeta – kanya. lemay hilcheta? rav chaviva amar: lemikne mammash.
Rabbanan amri: lekabbole aleh mi sheppara.
Vehilcheta lekabbole aleh "mi sheppara". uveatra dinhigu lemikne mammash – kanu.
Haya hu techilla lakkotzrim. amar rav: mechussar shetayim – posek. shalosh – eno posek. ushemuel amar: bide adam – afillu mea posek. bide shamayim – afillu achat eno posek.
Tenan: posek immo al haggadish, veha mechussar mishde bechamma lemevash ulemedash umidre! kegon dishda bechamma vivash.
Velishmuel, deamar: bide shamayim afillu achat eno posek, veha mechussar midre, devide shamayim hi – efshar benafvota.
Veal heavit shel anavim. veha mechussar michmar, veayyole leve matzarta, lemedash ulemingad! kidtane rabbi chiyyay: al hakkomer shel zetim, hacha name al hakkomer shel anavim.
Veha mechussere telat! beatra dehahu dezaven hu denaged.
Veal hammaatan shel zetim. veha mechussar michmar veayyole leve dappe lemedash ulemingad! tane rabbi chiyyay: al komer shel zetim. ha ikka telat! beatra dehahu dezaven hahu (menagged).
Veal habbetzim shel yotzer. ammay? veha mechussar lafofe veyabboshe, ayyole leattuna lemisraf ulemippak! kegon dimlaffa vivishu. veha ikka telat! beatra dehahu dezaven hu demappek.

Veal hassid mishsheyyeshakkeennu bakkivshan. veha mechussar mikle veappoke umedak! beatra dehahu dezaven hahu dayek. velishmuel deamar: bide adam afillu mea posek, lema li mishsheyyeshakkeennu bakkivshan? ema "mishsherauy leshakkeo bakkivshan".

Veal habbetzim shel yotzer. tanu rabbanan: en poskim al habbetzim shel yotzer ad sheyyeasu, divre rabbi meir. amar rabbi yose: bamme devarim amurim – beafar lavan, aval beafar shachor, kegon kefar chananya vechavroteha, kefar shichin vechavroteha – poskin, af al pi sheen leze yesh leze.

Ammemar yahev zuze mikki meayyeyli afra. keman? i kerabbi meir, haamar: ad sheyyeasu. i kerabbi yose, haamar: af al pi sheen leze yesh leze! leolam kerabbi yose, uveatreh deammemar ashik afra: i dimayyeyli afra samcha dateh veyahev lehu zuze, vei la – la samcha dateh.
Ufosek immo al hazzevel kol yemot hashshana. chachamim hayeynu tanna kamma? amar rava:
b: Yemot haggeshamim – ikka benayyhu.
Ufosek immo keshaar haggavoah.
Hahu gavra dihayv zuze linduneya deve chamu, lesof zal neduneya. ato lekammeh derav pappa. amar leh: i pesakt (immo) keshaar haggavoah – shekol kihasheta. vei la – shekol ki meikkara.

Amaru leh rabbanan lerav pappa: vei la pesak – shakel kemeikkara? maot ninhu, umaot la kanu! amar lehu: ana name lekabbole aleh "mi sheppara" ka amena. i pesak keshaar haggavoah, mocher ka hadar beh, mekabbel aleh mocher "mi sheppara". i la pesak – lokeach ka hadar beh, mekabbel aleh lokeach "mi sheppara".
Amar leh ravina lerav pappa: umimmay derabbanan hi difligi aleh derabbi shimon deamri maot la kanu, vaafillu hachi: i pesak keshaar haggavoah – shakel kidhashta, i la pesak – shakel kidmeikkara,

Dilma rabbi shimon hi, deamar maot konot: vechi pesak keshaar haggavoah – shakel ki hasheta, i la pesak – shakel kemeikkara, mishshum dekane lehu zuze. aval lerabbanan, ben pesak ben la pesak – shakel ki hasheta, dedateh deinish attara zila!
Amar leh: emor deamar rabbi shimon bechad tara, bitre tare mi amar? dei la tema hachi, "mi sheppara" belokeach – lerabbi shimon let leh!
Vechi tema: hachi name, vehatanya: mikkol makom kach halacha, aval amru chachamim "mi sheppara" kulei.
May mikkol makom? lav dela shena lokeach vela shena mocher mekabbel aleh "mi sheppara"? ella ki kaamar rabbi shimon: bechad tara, bitre tare la amar.
Amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe: vetippok leh deshaliach shavveyeh meikkara! amar leh: betaggara dezaven umezabben.

Mishna malve adam et arisav chittin bechittin lezera, aval lo leechol. shehaya rabban gamliel malve et arisav chittin bechittin lezera, beyoker vehuzelu, o bezol vehukeru – notel mehen keshaar hazzol. velo mippene shehalacha ken, ella sheratza lehachemir al atzmo.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: malve adam et arisav chittim bechittim lezera. bamme devarim amurim – shello yarad, aval yarad asur. may shena tanna didan dela ka mefalleg ben yarad uven lo yarad, umay shena tanna bara deka mefalleg ben yarad uven lo yarad?
Amar rava, rabbi idi asbera nihali: beatra detanna didan, arisa yahev bizra, ben yarad uven lo yarad – kamma dela yahev bizra matze mesallek leh, vechi ka nachet – livtzir mehachi ka nachet.
Beatra detanna bara, mare ara yahev bizra, i lo yarad dematze mesallek leh, ki ka nachet – livtzir mehachi ka nachet, i yarad dela matze mesallek leh – asur.
Tanu rabbanan, omer adam lachavero:

a: Haleveni kor chittin vekotzetz lo damim, huzelu – noten lo chittim, hukeru – noten demehem.
Vahalo katzatz! amar rav sheshet: hachi kaamar. im lo katzatz – huzelu – notel chittav. hukeru – noten demehem.

Mishna lo yomar adam lachavero: haleveni kor chittin vaani etten lach laggoren. aval omer lo: haleveni ad sheyyavo beni o ad sheemtza mafteach. vehillel oser. vechen haya hillel omer: lo talve ishsha kikkar lachavertah ad shettaaseha damim, shemma yukeru chittin, venimtzeu baot lide ribbit.
Gemara amar rav huna: yesh lo sea – love sea. satayim – love satayim. rabbi yitzchak omer: afillu yesh lo sea – love aleha kamma korin.
Tane rabbi chiyyay lesayyoeh lerabbi yitzchak: tippat yayin en lo, tippat shemen en lo. ha yesh lo – love aleha kamma tippin.
Vehillel oser. amar rav nachman amar shemuel: halacha kedivre hillel. velet hilcheta kevoteh.
Vechen haya hillel omer: lo talve ishsha [vechulei]. amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: zo divre hillel, aval chachamim omrim: lovim setam uforim setam.
Veamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: bene chavura hammakpidin ze al ze, ovrin mishshum midda umishshum mishkal umishshum minyan, umishshum lovin uforin beyom tov, uchedivre hillel af mishshum ribbit.

Veamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: talmide chachamim muttarim lilvot ze mizze beribbit. may tama – midda yadi deribbit asura, umattana hu deyahavi ahadade. amar leh shemuel laavu bar ihi: haleveni mea pilpelin bemea veesrin pilpelin, vaarich.
Amar rav yehuda amar rav: muttar lo laadam lehalevot banav uvene veto beribbit, kede lehateiman taam ribbit. velav milleta hi, mishshum deate lemisrach.
Mishna omer adam lachavero: nakkesh immi vaanakkesh immach, ador immi veeedor immach. velo yomar lo: nakkesh immi veeedor immach, ador immi vaanakkesh immach.
b: Kol yeme gerid – echad. kol yeme revia – achat. lo yomar lo: charosh immi bigrid vaani echrosh immecha barvia.

Rabban gamliel omer: yesh ribbit mukedemet veyesh ribbit meucheret. ketzad? natan enav lilvot hemennu, vehu meshalleach lo veomer: bishvil shettalveni – zo hi ribbit mukedemet. lava hemennu vehechzir lo et meotav, vehu meshalleach lo veomer: bishvil meotecha shehayu betelot etzli – zo hi ribbit meucheret.
Rabbi shimon omer: yesh ribbit devarim. lo yomar lo "da ki ba ish peloni mimmakom peloni".

Veellu ovrin belo taase: hammalve vehallove vehearev vehaedim. vachachamim omrim: af hassofer. ovrim mishshum "lo titten", umishshum "al tikkach meitto", umishshum "lo tihye lo kenoshe", umishshum "lo tesimun alav neshech", umishshum "velifne ivver lo titten michshol veyareta meelohecha ani Adonai".

Gemara tanya, rabbi shimon ben yochay omer: minnayin lannoshe bachavero mane, veeno ragil lehakedim lo shalom, sheasur lehakedim lo shalom – talmud lomar: "neshech kol davar asher yishshach" – afillu dibbur asur.

Veellu ovrin, amar abbaye: malve over bechullan. love over mishshum "lo tashshich leachicha". "uleachicha lo tashshich", "velifne ivver lo titten michshol". arev vehaedim en ovrin ella mishshum "lo tesimun alav neshech".

Tanya, rabbi shimon omer: malve ribbit yoter mimma shemmarvichim – mafsidim. velo od ella shemmesimim moshe rabbenu chacham vetorato emet. veomrin: illu haya yodea moshe rabbenu sheyyihye revach baddavar lo haya kotvo.
Ki ata rav dimi amar: minnayin lannoshe bachavero mane, veyodea sheen lo, sheasur laavor lefanav – talmud lomar: "lo tihye lo kenoshe".
Rabbi amme verabbi assi deamri tarvayyhu keillu dano bishne dinin, shenneemar: "hirkavta enosh leroshenu banu vaesh uvammayim".

Amar rav yehuda amar rav: kol mi sheyyesh lo maot umalve otan shello beedim – over mishshum "velifne ivver lo titten michshol". veresh lakish amar: gorem kelala leatzmo, shenneemar: "tealamna sifte shaker haddovrot al tzaddik atak".

Amaru leh rabbanan lerav ashe: ka mekayyem ravina kol ma daamur rabbanan. shelach leh bahade panya demaale shabbeta: lishaddar li mar asra zuze deitremi li kattina deara lemizban. shelach leh: nayte mar sahade venichtov ketava. shelach leh: afillu ana name? shelach leh: kol shekken mar ditrid begirseh mishtele vegorem kelala leatzmo.
Tanu rabbanan: shelosha tzoakin veenan naanin, veellu hen: mi sheyyesh lo maot umalve otan shello beedim, vehakkone adon leatzmo, umi sheishto moshelet alav.
Kona adon leatzmo may hi? ikka deamri: tole nechasav begoy. ikka deamri: hakkotev nechasav levanav bechayyav. ikka deamri: devish leh beha mata vela azel lemata achariti.
Hadaran alach ezehu neshech

Mishna hassocher et haummanin vehitu ze et ze – en lahem ze al ze ella taromet. sachar et hachammar veet hakkaddar lehavi periyayfarin vachalilim lakkalla o lammet, ufoalin lehaalot pishtano min hammishra, vechol davar sheaved vechazru bahen, makom sheen sham adam – socher alehen o matan.
Hassocher et haummanin vechazru bahen – yadam al hattachtona.

a: Im baal habbayit chozer bo – yado al hattachtona. kol hameshanne – yado al hattachtona, vechol hachozer bo – yado al hattachtona.
Gemara "chazru ze baze" la katane, ella "hitu ze et ze", deato poalim ahadade. hechi dame? daamar leh baal habbayit: zil, avgar li poalim, vaazal ihu veatinhu.

Hechi dame? i daamar leh baal habbayit bearbea, vaazayl ihu amar lehu bitlata – taromet may avidteh? sevur vekabbel. i daamar leh baal habbayit bitlata, vaazayl ihu amar lehu bearbea – hechi dame? i daamar lehu: "secharchem alay" – nittev lehu middideh,
Detanya: hassocher et happoel laasot beshello veherahu beshel chavero – noten lo secharo mishshalem, vechozer venotel mibbaal habbayit ma shehehenahu.
La tzericha, daamar lehu secharchem al baal habbayit.
Velichze poalim hechi mittagri? la tzericha, deikka demittegar bearbea veikka demittegar bitlata, deamru leh: i lav daamart lan bearbea – tarchinan umittagrinan bearbea.
Ibbaet ema: hacha bevaal habbayit askinan, deamru leh: i lav daamart lan bearbea, hava zila ban milleta leittegore.
Ibbaet ema: leolam befoalim askinan, deamri leh: kevan daamart lan bearbea – tarchinan veavdinan lach avidta shappirta. velichze avidtayyhu? berifka. rifka name midda yedia? dimle mayya vela yedia.
Ibbaet ema: leolam daamar leh baal habbayit bearbea, vaazal ihu amar lehu bitlata, udekaamrat sevur vekabbel, deamri leh let lacha "al timna tov mibbealav"?
Peshita i amar leh baal habbayit bitlata, vaazal ihu amar lehu bearbea, veamri leh kemo sheamar baal habbayit – datayyhu ailluya.

Ella i amar leh baal habbayit bearbea, vaazal ihu amar lehu bitlata, veamri: kema sheamar baal habbayit, may? addibbura dideh ka samchi, deamri leh mehemnat lan dehachi amar baal habbayit, o dilma addibbura devaal habbayit ka samchi?
Ta shema: "have li gitti".
Veishtecha amra "hitkabbel li gitti", vehu omer: "helach kema sheamra". amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu amar rav: afillu higgia get leyadah – enah megoreshet.
Shamat minna addibbura dideh ka samech. dei salka datach deaddibbura dida ka samech – mikki mate gitta lida miha tiggarash. amar rav ashe:
b: Hachi hasheta?! bishlama i ittemar ippecha, "hitkabbel li gitti" veishtecha amra, "have li gitti", vehu omer: "helach kemo sheamra". veamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu amar rav: mishsheyyaggia get leyado – megoreshet, alma deaddibbura dida ka semich.

I name: mishshehiggia get leyadah megoreshet – alma deaddibbura dideh ka samech. ella hatam – mishshum deakar shaliach lishlichuteh ligmare, deamar leh: "shaliach likabbala havena, leholacha la havena".
Ibbaet ema: hay tanna "chazru" name "hitu" kare leh, detanya: hassocher et haummanin vehitu et baal habbayit, o baal habbayit hita otan – en lahem ze al ze ella taromet.

Bamme devarim amurim? shello halchu. aval halchu chammarim velo matzu tevua, poalin umatzu sade keshehi lacha – noten lahen secharan mishshalem, aval eno dome habba taun labba rekan, ose melacha leyoshev uvatel.

Bamme devarim amurim? shello hitchilu bimlacha, aval hitchilu bimlacha – shamin lahen ma sheasu. ketzad? kibbelu kama liktzor bishne selaim, katzru chetzyah vehinnichu chetzyah. beged leerog bishne selaim, argu chetzyo vehinnichu chetzyo – shamin lahen et ma sheasu.
Haya yafe shishsha dinarim – noten lahen sela, o yigmeru melachtan veyittelu shene selaim. veim sela – noten lahem sela.
Rabbi dosa omer: shamin lahen ma sheatid leheasot, haya yafe shishsha dinarim – noten lahem shekel, o yigmeru melachtan veyittelu shene selaim. veim sela – noten lahem sela.

Bamme devarim amurim? bedavar sheen avud, aval bedavar haavud – socher alehen o matan. ketzad matan? omer lahen: sela katzatzti lachem – bou utelu shetayim. vead kamma socher alehen? ad arbaim vachamishshim zuz.
Bamme devarim amurim? bizman sheen sham poalim liskor. aval yesh sham poalim liskor, veamar: "tze usechor meellu" – en lo alehen ella taromet.

Tane tanna kammeh derav: noten lahem secharan mishshalem. amar leh: chavivi amar, illu ana havay – la hava yahevna lahen ella kefoel batel, veat amrat noten lahem secharan mishshalem! veha ala katane: eno dome habba taun lehabba rekan, ose melacha leyoshev uvatel! la sayyeymuha kammeh.
Ikka deamri: sayyeymuha kammeh, vehachi kaamar. chavivi amar: i havay ana – la hava yahevna leh kelal, veat amrat kefoel batel! ella kashya hach.
La kashya: ha desayyeyra leareh middeureta, ha dela sayyeyra leareh meureta.
Ki ha deamar rava: hay man daagar agire lerifka vaata mitra umalyay mayya, i sayyeyra leareh meureta –

a: Peseda defoalim, la sayyeyra leareh meureta – peseda devaal habbayit veyahev lehu kefoel batel.
Veamar rava: hay man deogayr agire ledavvla, vaata mitra – peseda defoalim. ata nahara – peseda devaal habbayit, veyahev lehu kefoel batel.
Veamar rava: hay man deogayr agire ledavvla, ufesak nahara befalga deyoma, i la avid defasek – peseda defoalim. avid defasek – i bene mata, peseda defoalim. lav bene mata – peseda devaal habbayit.

Veamar rava: hay man daagar agire laavidta, ushelim avidta befalga deyoma, i it leh avidta denicha minna – yahev lehu, i name dichvata – mefakked lehu, (dekashe) [dekashya] minna – la mefakked lehu, venoten lahem secharan mishshalem.
Ammay? velittev lehu kefoel batel! ki kaamar rava, beachloshe demachoza, dei la avdi – chalshi.
Amar mar: shamin lahem et ma sheasu, ketzad? haya yafe shishsha dinarim – noten lahem sela. ka savri rabbanan: yad poel al haelyona.

O yigmeru melachtan veyittelu shene selaim. peshita! la tzericha: deiyyaykkar avidta veimmeru poalim vaazal baal habbayit ufayyeysinhu. mahu detema, matzu amri leh: ki mefayyeysinan – addata detafet lan aagra, ka mashma lan deamar lehu: addata detarachna lechu baachila ushetiyya.
Sela noten lahem sela. peshita! la tzericha – dezal avidta meikkara, veagrinhu bitfe zuza, ulesof iyyaykkar avidta vekam bitfe zuza.
Mahu detema amri leh: tefe zuza amart lan – tefe zuza hav lan, ka mashma lan daamar lehu, ki amari lechu tefe zuza: dela hava kim lechu, hasheta kim lechu.
Rabbi dosa omer: shamin lahen et ma sheatid leheasot, haya yafe shishsha dinarim noten lahem shekel. kasavar yad poel al hattachtona.

O yigmeru melachtan veyittelu shene selaim. peshita! la tzericha dezal avidta veimmar baal habbayit, vaazul poalim ufayyeysu. mahu detema, matze amar lehu: addata devatzritu li meagrayy. ka mashma lan deamri leh: addata deavdinan lach avidta shappirta.
Sela noten lahem sela. peshita! amar rav huna bereh derav natan: la tzericha deozilu inhu gabbeh zuza meikkara, ulesof zal avidta.
Mahu detema: betzir zuza amritu li – betzir zuza yahevna lechu, ka mashma lan deamri leh: ki amarna lach bivtzir zuza – dela hava kim lach, hasheta kim lach.

Amar rav: halacha kerabbi dosa. umi amar rav hachi? vehaamar rav: poel yachol lachazor bo afillu bachatzi hayyom! vechi tema shane leh lerabbi dosa ben sechirut lekabbelanut, umi shane leh? vehatanya: hassocher et happoel, velachatzi hayyom shama shemmet lo met, o sheachazattu chamma, im sachir hu –
b: Noten lo secharo, im kabbelan hu – noten lo kabbelanuto.

Manni? illema rabbanan, may irya shama shemmet lo met o sheachazattu chamma daanis, ki la anis name – ha amaru rabbanan yad poel al haelyona! ella lav rabbi dosa hi, ushema minna la shane leh lerabbi dosa ben sechirut lekabbelanut.
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: bedavar haavud, vedivre hakkol.

Tenan: kol hameshanne yado al hattachtona, vechol hachozer bo yado al hattachtona. bishlama kol hameshanne yado al hattachtona, distam lan tanna kerabbi yehuda. ella kol hachozer bo yado al hattachtona leetoye may? lav leetoye poel ucherabbi dosa?
Ella rabbi dosa tarte kaamar, verav savar la kevoteh bachada ufaleg aleh bachada.

Ibbaet ema: "kol hachozer bo yado al hattachtona", lechidtanya: kol hachozer bo ketzad? hare shemmachar sade lachavero beelef zuz, venatan lo maot mehen matayim zuz. bizman shehammocher chozer bo – yad lokeach al haelyona.

Ratza – omer lo: "ten li meotay", o: "ten li karka keneged meotay". mehechan magbehu? min haiddit. uvizman shellokeach chozer bo – yad mocher al haelyona, ratza omer lo: "helach meotecha", ratza omer "helach karka keneged meotecha". mehechan magbehu? min hazzibburit.

Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: melammedin otan shello yachzeru. ketzad? kotev lo: "ani peloni ben peloni macharti sade pelonit lifloni beelef zuz, venatan li mehem matayim zuz, vahareni noshe bo shemone meot zuz", kana umachazir lo et hashshear, afillu leachar kamma shanim.
Amar mar: mehechan magbehu? min haiddit. ka salka datach meiddit dinchasav. velo yehe ella baal chov! utenan: baal chov dino bevenonit. veod: ha ara deyahev zuze?
Amar rabbi nachman bar yitzchak: meiddit shebbah, umizzibburit shebbah.
Rav acha bereh derav ika amar: afillu tema meiddit dinchasav, setam man dezaven ara bealpa zuze – ozole mozel umezabben nechasav, vehave leh kenizzak. utenan: hannizzakin shamin lahen beiddit.
Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: melammedin otan shello yachzeru. ketzad? kotev lo: "ani peloni ben peloni kulei". tama dichtav leh hachi, ha la ketav hachi – la kane?
Vehatanya: hannoten eravon lachavero veamar lo "im ani chozer bi, ervoni machul lach", vehalla omer: "im ani chozer bi, echpol lach ervoncha" – nitkayyeymu hattenain, divre rabbi yose.
Rabbi yose letameh deamar: asmachta kanya.

Rabbi yehuda omer: dayyo sheyyikne keneged ervono. amar rabban shimon ben gamliel: bamme devarim amurim – bizman sheamar lo "ervoni yikkon". aval machar lo sade beelef zuz venatan lo mehem chamesh meot zuz – kana, umachzir lo et hashshear afillu leachar kamma shanim!
La kashya: ha deka ayel venafek azzuze, ha dela ka ayel venafek azzuze.
Deamar rava: hay man dezabben midde lechavreh veka ayel venafek azzuze – la kane. la ka ayel venafek azzuze – kane.
Veamar rava: hay man deozfeh mea zuze lechavreh ufareh zuza zuza – peraon have, ella deit leh taromet gabbeh. deamar leh: afsadtinhu minnay.

Hahu gavra dezabben leh chamara lechavreh ufash leh chad zuza, veka ayel venafek azzuza. yatev rav ashe veka meayyen ba: ki hay gavvna may: kane o la kane? amar leh rav mardochay lerav ashe: hachi amar avimi mehageronya mishshemeh derava: zuza kezuze dame, vela kane.
Amar leh rav acha bereh derav yosef lerav ashe: veha amrinan mishshemeh derava kane! amar leh: tittargam shemataycha bemocher sadehu

a: Mippene raatah.

Peshita: bae lezabbone bima vela ashkach, vezabben bematayim, veka ayel venafek azzuze – la kane. ella i bae lezabbone bima vela ashkach, vei tarach hava mashkach, vela terach vezabben bematayim, veka ayel venafek azzuze – may: kemocher sadehu mippene raatah dame, o la? teku.
Sachar et hachammar veet hakkaddar vechulei socher alehen o matan. ad kamma socher alehen? amar rav nachman: ad kede secharan.
Etiveh rava lerav nachman: ad arbaim vachamishshim zuz! amar leh: ki tanya hahi – shebbata chavila leyado.

Mishna hassocher et hachamor leholicho bahar veholicho babbika, babbika veholicho bahar, afillu zo eser milin vezo eser milin, umeta – chayyayv. hassocher et hachamor leholichah bahar veholicha babbika, im hechlika – patur, veim huchama – chayyayv. leholichah babbika veholicha bahar, im hechlika – chayyayv, veim huchamma – patur, im mechamat hammaala – chayyayv.
Hassocher et hachamor vehivrika o shennaaset angarya – omer lo: hare shellecha lefanecha. meta o nishbera – chayyayv lehaamid [lo] chamor.
Gemara may shena resha dela ka mefalleg, umay shena sefa deka mefalleg?

Amri deve rabbi yannay: resha shemmeta mechamat avir, deamrinan avvera dehar katla, veamrinan avvera devika katla. rabbi yose bar chanina amar: kegon shemmeta mechamat uvetzana. rabba amar: kegon shehikkishah nachash.
Rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: ha manni rabbi meir hi, deamar: kol hammaavir al daat shel baal habbayit,
b: Nikra gazlan.
He rabbi meir? ilema rabbi meir detzabba, ditnan: hannoten tzemer latzabba litzboa lo adom utzevao shachor, shachor utzevao adom, rabbi meir omer: noten lo deme tzamro.
Rabbi yehuda omer: im hashshevach yater al hayyetzia – noten lo et hayyetzia, veim hayyetzia yetera al hashshevach – noten lo et hashshevach.
Mimmay: dilma shane hatam dekanye beshinnuy maase?

Ella ha rabbi meir demigbat purim, detanya: migbat purim – lefurim. migbat hair – leotah hair, veen medakdekin baddavar. aval lokchin et haagalim veshochatin veochlim otan, vehammotar yippol lechis shel tzedaka.

Rabbi eliezer omer: migbat purim lefurim, veen heani rashshay likkach mehen retzua lesandalo, ella im ken hitna bemaamad anshe hair, divre rabbi yaakov sheamar mishshum rabbi meir. verabban shimon ben gamliel mekel.
Dilma hatam name, deaddata defurim hu deyahev leh, addata demidde acharina la yahev leh.

Ella ha rabbi meir, detanya, rabbi shimon ben elazar omer mishshum rabbi meir: hannoten dinar leani likkach lo chaluk – lo yikkach bo tallit, tallit – lo yikkach bo chaluk, mippene shemmaavir al dato shel baal habbayit.
Vedilma shane hatam deatu lemichshedeh, deamri inashe, amar pelanya: zavenyna leh levusha lifloni anya, vela zevan leh. i name, zavenyna leh gelima vela zevan leh.
Im ken, litne: "mippene hachashad", may: "mippene shemmaavir al dato shel baal habbayit" – shema minna mishshum doshanni hu, vechol hammaavir al daat shel baal habbayit nikra gazlan.
Hassocher et hachamor vehivrika, may "vehivrika"? hacha targimu "nehorita". rava amar: avzekat.
Hahu daamar lehu: avzekat bemelata demalka, amaru leh: bemay? betalle chesaf, o betalle dehav? ikka deamri: betalle chesaf amar, vekatlu. ikka deamri: betalle dehav amar, veshavku.
O shennaaset angarya, omer lo: hare shellecha lefanecha. amar rav: lo shanu ella beangarya chozeret. aval angarya sheenah chozeret, chayyayv lehaamid lo chamor.
Ushemuel amar: ben angarya chozeret ben angarya sheenah chozeret, im bederech halicha nittela – omer lo: hare shellecha lefanecha. veim lav bederech halichatah nittela – chayyayv lehaamid lo chamor.
Metivi: hassocher et hachamor vehivrika o shennishtatteta, omer lo: hare shellecha lefanecha. meta o shennaaset angarya – chayyayv lehaamid lo chamor.
Bishlama lerav la kashya: kan beangarya chozeret, kan beangarya sheenah chozeret. ella lishmuel kashya!
Vechi tema lishmuel name la kashya: kan shebbederech halichatah nittela, kan shello bederech halichatah nittela.
Ha middekatane sefa: rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: im bederech halichatah nittela, omer lo: hare shellecha lefanecha, veim lav – chayyayv lehaamid lo chamor. mikkelal diltanna kamma la shane leh!

Amar lecha shemuel: lav mi ikka rabbi shimon ben elazar dekae kevoti? ana daamari kerabbi shimon ben elazar. ibbaet ema kullah rabbi shimon ben elazar hi, vechassore michassera vehachi katane: hassocher et hachamor vehivrika o nishtattet, omer lo: hare shellecha lefanecha. meta o shennaaset angarya – chayyayv lehaamid lo chamor. bamme devarim amurim – shello bederech halichatah nittela, aval nittela bederech halichatah – omer lo: hare shellecha lefanecha.

a: Divre rabbi shimon ben elazar. shehaya rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: im bederech hilluchah nittela – omer lo: hare shellecha lefanecha, veim lo – chayyayv lehaamid lo chamor.

Umi matzet mokmat la kerabbi shimon ben elazar? veha katane resha: hassocher et hachamor vehivrika o shennishtatteta, omer lo: hare shellecha lefanecha. veillu rabbi shimon ben elazar amar: hassocher et hachamor lirkov aleha vehivrika o shennishtatteta – chayyayv lehaamid lo chamor!
Amar rabba bar rav huna: lirkov aleha shane. amar rav pappa: uchele zechuchit – kelirkov aleha dame.
Amar rabba bar rav huna amar rav: hassocher et hachamor lirkov aleha umeta lo bachatzi hadderech, noten lo secharo shel chatzi hadderech, veen lo alav ella taromet.
Hechi dame? i dishchiach leogore – taromet may avidteh? i dela shechiach leogore – agra bae lemittav leh!
Leolam dela shechiach leogore, umishshum deamar leh: illu baet lemete ad hacha – lav agra baet lemittav?
Hechi dame? i daamar leh: "chamor setam" – ha chayyayv lehaamid lo chamor acher. i daamar leh: "chamor ze", im yesh bedameha likkach yikkach!
La tzericha: besheen bedameha likkach. im yesh bedameha liskor – yiskor, rav letameh, deamar rav: la mechallenan karna.
Deittemar: hassocher et hachamor umeta lo bachatzi hadderech. amar rav: im yesh bedameha likkach – yikkach, liskor – al yiskor. ushemuel amar: af liskor – yiskor.
Bemay kamippalgi? rav savar: la mechallenan karna. ushemuel savar: mechallenan karna.
Metivi, yavesh hailan o niktzatz – shenehem asurin bo. ketzad yaase? yillakach bo karka, vehu ochel perot. veha hacha, kevan dechi mate yovel ka hadra ara lemara, veka chalya karna!

Hacha bemay askinan – dezabben leh leshittin shenin. deamar rav chisda amar rav kattina: minnayin lammocher sadehu leshishshim shana sheenah chozeret bayyovel – shenneemar: "vehaaretz lo timmacher litzmitut". mi sheen sham yovel – nitzmetet, yesh sham yovel – enah nitzmetet. yatzta zo, sheaf al pi sheen sham yovel – enah nitzmetet.

Sof sof, lechi matu shittin shenin – ka hadra ara lemara, veka chalya karna! ella, hacha bemay askinan – bizman sheen hayyovel noheg. hachi name mistabbera, dei salka datach bizman shehayyovel noheg umechallenan karna, nitzlecheh letzive venishkeleh!
I mishshum ha – la kashya: zimnin deshalmu shene mashkanta mikkamme yovel. i name dematu leh zuze ufarek la arba vechamesh shenin mikkamme yovel.
Tanu rabbanan: hassocher et hassefina vetava lah bachatzi hadderech, rabbi natan omer: im natan – lo yittol, veim lo natan – lo yitten.
Hechi dame? illema bisfina zo veyayin setam, im natan ammay lo yittol? nema leh: hav li sefinta, daana mayytena chamra. ella bisfina setam veyayin ze, im lo natan ammay lo yitten?
b: Nema leh: hav li hahu chamra vaana mayytena sefinta.
Amar rav pappa: la mashkachat la ella bisfina zo veyayin ze. aval bisfina setam veyayin setam – cholkin.

Tanu rabbanan: hassocher et hassefina uferakah lah bachatzi hadderech – noten lo secharo shel chatzi hadderech, veen lo alav ella taromet. hechi dame? illema deka mashkach leogora – ammay it leh taromet? vei dela ka mashkach leogora – kulleh agra bae shallome!
Leolam deka mashkach leogora, ella ammay it leh taromet – mishshum rafseta disfinta. i hachi, taanta meallayyta hiv umamona it leh gabbeh.
Ella may perakah – defarke letueneh begavvay. ella may taromet – mishshum shinnuy data. i name leashla yattira.

Tanu rabbanan: hassocher et hachamor lirkov aleha – socher manniach aleha kesuto uleginoto umezonot shel otah hadderech, mikkan veelach – chammar meakkev alav. chammar manniach alav seorim veteven umezonotav shel oto hayyom, mikkan veelach – socher meakkev alav.
Hechi dame? i dishchiach lemizban – chammar name liakkev, vei dela shechiach lemizban – socher name la liakkev!
Amar rav pappa: la tzericha dishchiach lemitrach ulemizban meauona leauona, chammar darkeh lemitrach ulemizban. socher lav darkeh lemitrach ulemizban.
Tanu rabbanan: hassocher et hachamor lirkov aleha ish – lo tirkav aleha ishsha. ishsha – rochev aleha ish. veishsha, ben gedola uven ketanna, afillu meubberet, vaafillu menika.
Hasheta menika amrat, meubberet mibbaya? amar rav pappa: meubberet vehi menika kaamar.
Amar abbaye: shema minna binita akkeresa takla. lemay nafka minna? lemikkach umimkar.

a: Mishna hassocher et happara lacharosh bahar vecharash babbika, im nishbar hakkankan – patur. babbika vecharash bahar, im nishbar hakkankan – chayyayv. ladush bekitnit vedash bitvua – patur, ladush bitvua vedash bekitnit – chayyayv, mippene shehakkitnit machleket.

Gemara hecha dela shanni bah, man meshallem? amar rav pappa: denaket perasha meshallem. rav shisha bereh derav idi amar: denaket mana meshallem. vehilcheta: denaket mana meshallem. vei ducheta demachzeki (gunedre) – [gerunede] tarvayyhu meshallemin.

Amar rabbi yochanan: hammocher para lachavero, veamar lo: para zo nagchanit hi, nashchanit hi, baatanit hi, ravtzanit hi, vehaya bah mum echad usenafo ben hammumin – hare ze mikkach taut. mum ze umum acher – en ze mikkach taut.

Tanya name hachi: hammocher shifcha lachavero, veamar lo: shifcha zo shota hi, nichpet hi, meshuememet hi, vehaya bah mum echad usenafo ben hammumin – hare ze mikkach taut. mum ze umum acher – en ze mikkach taut.
Amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe: hayu bah kol hammumin hallalu, mahu? amar leh rav mardochay lerav ashe, hachi amrinan mishshemeh derava: hayu bah kol hammumin hallalu – en ze mikkach taut.

Mishna hassocher et hachamor lehavi aleha chittin, vehevi aleha seorin – chayyayv. tevua, vehevi aleha teven – chayyayv, mippene shehannefach kashe kemassooy. lehavi letech chittin, vehevi letech seorin – patur. veim mosif al massao chayyayv. vechamma yosif al massao vihe chayyayv? somchos omer mishshum rabbi meir: sea legamal, shelosha kabbin lachamor.

Gemara ittemar. abbaye amar: "kashe kemassoy" tenan. rava amar: "kashe lemassoy" tenan. abbaye amar: "kashe kemassoy" tenan, nifcha ki tikla, vei mosif shelosha kabbin – chayyayv. rava amar: "kashe lemassoy" tenan, tikla ki tikla venifcha have tosefet.

Tenan: lehavi letech chittin, vehevi letech seorin – patur. veim hosif al massao – chayyayv. may lav sheloshet kabbin?! lo, sea. veha ala katane: vechamma yosif al massao vihe chayyayv? somchos omer mishshum rabbi meir: sea legamal, shelosha kabbin lachamor!
Hachi kaamar: hecha dela shanni chittin vehevi chittin, seorin vehevi seorin, kamma yosif al massao vihe chayyayv? somchos omer mishshum rabbi meir: sea legamal shelosha kabbin lachamor.
Ta shema: lehavi letech chittin vehevi
b: Shesh esre seorim – chayyayv. ha sheloshet kabbin – patur! targema abbaye: bimchikata.
Tanu rabbanan: kav lechattaf, adriv laareva. kor lisfina, sheloshet korim levureni gedola.

Amar mar: kav lechattaf. im ita dela matze beh bar daat hu, lishdeye! amar abbaye: beshechavato lealtar. rava amar: afillu tema beshello chavato lealtar, la tzericha ella leagra yattira. rav ashe amar: hu savur chulesha hu denaket leh.
Kor lisfina, sheloshet korin levureni gedola. amar rav pappa: shema minna setam sefinot bat telatin korin. lemay nafka minna? lemikkach umimkar.

Mishna kol haummanin – shomre sachar hen. vechullan sheamru: tol et shellecha vehave maot – shomer chinnam. shemor li veeshmor lach – shomer sachar. shemor li, veamar lo: hannach lefanay – shomer chinnam.

Hilvahu al hammashkon – shomer sachar. rabbi yehuda omer: hilvahu maot – shomer chinnam, hilvahu perot – shomer sachar. abba shaul omer: rashshay adam lehasekir mashkono shel ani lihyot posek veholech alav, mippene shehu kemeshiv aveda.
Gemara lema matnitin dela kerabbi meir? detanya: socher ketzad meshallem? rabbi meir omer: keshomer chinnam. rabbi yehuda omer: keshomer sachar.

Afillu tema rabbi meir, behahi hanaa deka shavek kulle alma veagayr leh ledideh – have illaveh shomer sachar. i hachi, socher name behahi hanaa deka shavek kulle alma umogar leh ledideh – have illaveh shomer sachar.
Ella: afillu tema rabbi meir, behahi hanaa deka yahev leh tefe pureta – have illaveh shomer sachar.
Socher name! mi la askinan deka meshavve leh tefe pureta. ella afillu tema rabbi meir, behahi hanaa detafes leh aagreh, dela bae lemeal ulemippak azzuze – have aleh shomer sachar.
Ibbaet ema, kidmachlef rabba bar avu vetane: socher ketzad meshallem? rabbi meir omer: keshomer sachar, rabbi yehuda omer: keshomer chinnam.
Vechullan sheamru: "tol et shellecha vehave maot" – shomer chinnam. tenan hatam: amar lo shoel "shallach", veshillechah umeta – chayyayv, vechen beshaa shemmachzirah.

Amar rafram bar pappa amar rav chisda: lo shanu ella shehechzirah betoch yeme sheelatah. aval leachar yeme sheelatah – patur. metiv rav nachman bar pappa: vechullan sheamru "tol et shellecha vehave maot" – shomer chinnam.

a: Ha "gemartiv" – shomer sachar. la, ha "have maot vetol et shellecha" – shomer sachar.
Aval "gemartiv" may shomer chinnam? i hachi, addetane "vechullan sheamru tol et shellecha vehave maot – shomer chinnam", nashmeinan "gemartiv", vechol shekken "tol et shellecha"!
"Tol et shellecha" itztericha leh. salka datach amena: shomer chinnam name la have, ka mashma lan.
Ikka deamri, amar rav nachman bar pappa: af anan name tenena, vechullan sheamru "tol et shellecha vehave maot" – shomer chinnam, may lav hu haddin "gemartiv". lo, "tol et shellecha" shane.

Huna mar bar marimar kammeh deravina rame matnitin ahadade umeshanne. tenan: vechullan sheamru "tol et shellecha vehave maot" – shomer chinnam. vehu haddin ligmartiv". ureminhu: amar lo shoel "shallach", veshillechah umeta – chayyayv. vechen beshaa shemmachzirah. umeshanne, amar rafram bar pappa amar rav chisda: lo shanu ella shehechzir betoch yeme sheelatah, aval leachar yeme sheelatah, patur.
Ibbaya lehu: patur mishshoel vechayyayv keshomer sachar, o dilma shomer sachar name la have? amar ammemar: mistabbera patur mishshoel vechayyayv keshomer sachar, hoil venehene mehanne have.

Tanya kevoteh deammemar: hallokeach kelim mibbet haumman leshaggeran levet chamiv, veamar lo: im mekabbelin otan mimmenni – ani noten lecha demehen, veim lav – ani noten lecha lefi tovat hanaa shebbahen, veneensu bahalicha – chayyayv,
Bachazira – patur, mippene shehu kenose sachar.

Hahu gavra dezabben leh chamara lechavreh, amar leh: ka mamtena lay leducheta peloni, i mizdabbena – mutav, vei la – mahdarna lay nihalaych. azal vela izdabbena, uvahade deka ate ittenis. ata lekammeh derav nachman, chayyeyveh.
Etiveh rabba lerav nachman: neensu, bahalicha – chayyayv, uvachazara – patur, mippene shehu kenose sachar!
Amar leh: chazara dehay – halicha hi. may tama? sevara hu: bachazirato, illu ashkach lezabboneh mi la zabbene?
"Shemor li veeshmor lach" – shomer sachar. veammay? shemira bivalim hi! amar rav pappa: daamar leh "shemor li hayyom veeshmor lecha lemachar".

Tanu rabbanan: "shemor li veeshmor lach", "hasheileni veashilecha", "shemor li veashilecha", "hasheileni veeshmor lach" – kullan naasu shomre sachar ze laze. veammay, shemira bivalim hi! amar rav pappa: daamar leh, "shemor li hayyom veeshmor lecha lemachar".

Hanhu ahaloye dechol yoma hava afe le[u] chad minnayyhu. hahu yoma amaru leh lechad minnayyhu: zil afi lan. amar lehu: netaru li gelimay. addaata peshau be (veiggenuv) [veiggeniv] ato. lekammeh derav pappa, chayyeyvinhu.
Amaru leh rabbanan lerav pappa: ammay? peshia bivalim hi! ikkesif. lesof iggallay milleta dehahu shata shichra hava ka shate.

Hanicha leman deamar peshia bivalim patur – mishshum hachi ikkesif, ella leman deamar chayyayv – ammay ikkesif? ella hahu yoma lav dideh hava, vaamaru leh ledideh: zil afi lan at, vaamar lehu: behahu agra deka afena lechu neturu gelimay.
b: Ad daata – iggeniv. ato lekammeh derav pappa chayyeyvinhu. amaru leh rabbanan lerav pappa: ha shemira bivalim hi! ikkesif. lesof iggallay milleta dehahi shata shichra hava shate.

Hanhu be tere dahavo ka mesaggu beorcha, chad arich vechad gutza. aricha rechiv chamara vahava leh sedina, gutza mikkasse sarbala veka mesagge bechareh. ki meto lenahara, shakleh lesarbaleh veotveh illave chamara, veshakleh lisdineh dehahu veikkassi beh. shatfu mayya lisdineh.
Ata lekammeh derava, chayyeyveh. amaru leh rabbanan lerava: ammay? sheela bivalim hi! ikkesif. lesof iggallay milleta divla dateh shakleh, uvela dateh otveh.

Hahu gavra deogar leh chamara lechavreh, amar leh: chazi, la tezol beorcha dinhar pekod deikka mayya, zil beorcha denaresh delekka mayya. azel beorcha dinhar pekod umit chamra. ki ata, amar: in, beorcha dinhar pekod azali, umihu lekka mayya.
Amar leh rava: ma leh leshakker, i bae amar leh: ana beorcha denaresh azali. amar leh abbaye: "ma li leshakker" bimkom edim – la amrinan.

"Shemor li", veamar lo "hannach lefanay" – shomer chinnam. amar rav huna: amar lo hannach lefanecha – eno lo shomer chinnam velo shomer sachar. ibbaya lehu: hannach setama, may? ta shema: shemor li veamar lo hannach lefanay – shomer chinnam. ha setama – velo kelum.
Adderabba, middeamar rav huna: "hannach lefanecha" – hu deeno lo shomer chinnam velo shomer sachar, ha setama shomer chinnam have! ella meha lekka lemishma minna.
Lema ketannae: im hichnis birshut baal chatzer – chayyayv. rabbi omer: bechullam eno chayyayv ad sheyyekabbel alav baal habbayit lishmor.

Mimmay? dilma ad kan la kaamri rabbanan hatam ella bechatzer devat nattore hi, vechi kaamar leh "ayyel" – "ayyel deintar lach" kaamar leh. aval hacha, shuka lav bar nattore hu, "annach vetiv netar lach" kaamar leh.

I name: ad kan la kaamar rabbi hatam ella bachatzero, dilayyole reshuta ka vae lemishkal minneh vechi yahev leh reshuta leayyole – "tiv venattar lach" kaamar leh. aval hacha – "hannach vaana menattarna" kaamar leh. dei salka datach "hannach vetiv venattar" kaamar leh, i leotove, reshuta bae lemishkal minneh?
Hilvahu al hammashkon – shomer sachar. lema matnitin dela kerabbi eliezer? detanya: hammalve et chavero al hammashkon veavad hammashkon – yishshava veyittol meotav, divre rabbi eliezer.

Rabbi akiva omer: yachol lomar lo: kelum hilvitani ella al hammashkon? avad hammashkon – avdu meotecha. aval hilvahu elef zuz bishtar vehinniach lo mashkon alehem, divre hakkol: avad hammashkon – avdu meotav.
Afillu tema rabbi eliezer, vela kashya: kan – shemmishkeno bishat halevaato, kan – shemmishkeno shello bishat halevaato.
Veha idde veidde,

a: Hilvahu al hammashkon katane! ella la kashya: kan – shehilvahu maot, kan – shehilvahu perot.
Veha middekatane sefa, rabbi yehuda omer: hilvahu maot – shomer chinnam, hilvahu perot – shomer sachar. michlal diltanna kamma la shane leh!

Kulla rabbi yehuda hi, vechassore michassera vehachi katane: hilvahu al hammashkon – shomer sachar, bamme devarim amurim – shehilvahu perot, aval hilvahu maot – shomer chinnam. sherabbi yehuda omer: hilvahu maot – shomer chinnam, hilvahu perot – shomer sachar.
I hachi, kama la matnitin dela kerabbi akiva. ella mechavvavrta matnitin dela kerabbi eliezer.
Lema bidla shave mashkon shiur zuze, uvedishmuel ka mippalgi. deamar shemuel: hay man deozfeh alpa zuze lechavreh veannach leh katta demaggela illavayyhu, avad katta demaggela – avadu alpa zuze.
I bidla shave mashkon shiur zuze – dechulle alma let lehu dishmuel, vehacha bidshave shiur zuze, veka mippalgi bidrabbi yitzchak.
