Deamar rabbi yitzchak: minnayin levaal chov shekkone mashkon, shenneemar: "ulecha tihye tzedaka". im eno kone mashkon, tzedaka mena leh? mikkan levaal chov shekkone mashkon.
Vetisbera? emor deamar rabbi yitzchak bemishkeno shello bishat halevaato, aval mishkeno bishat halevaato – mi amar?

Ella mishkeno shello bishat halevaato – kulle alma it lehu derabbi yitzchak. vehacha bemishkeno bishat halevaato, uveshomer aveda ka mippalgi. deittemar: shomer aveda, rabba amar: keshomer chinnam, rav yosef amar: keshomer sachar.
Lema derav yosef tannae hi? la, beshomer aveda – dechulle alma it lehu derav yosef, vehacha
b: Bemilve tzarich lemashkon kamippalgi. mar savar: mitzva ka aved shehilvahu, vehave shomer sachar. umar savar: lav mitzva ka aved, shellahanaato mitkavven, vehave shomer chinnam.

Abba shaul omer: muttar laadam lehasekir mashkono shel ani lihyot pochet veholech. amar rav chanan bar amme amar shemuel: halacha keabba shaul. veaf abba shaul la amar ella bemara ufasal vekardom, hoil unefish agrayyhu vezutar pechatayyhu.
Mishna hammaavir chavit mimmakom lemakom ushevarah, ben shomer chinnam ben shomer sachar – yishshava. rabbi eliezer omer: ze veze yishshava, vetameah ani im yecholin ze vaze lishshava.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: hammaavir chavit lachavero mimmakom lemakom ushevarah, ben shomer chinnam ben shomer sachar – yishshava, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: shomer chinnam – yishshava, nose sachar – yeshallem. rabbi eliezer omer: ze veze yishshava, vetameah ani im yecholin ze vaze lishshava.

Lememra desavar rabbi meir nitkal lav poshea hu? vehatanya: nishbera kaddo velo sillekah nafla gemallo velo heemidah, rabbi meir mechayyev behezzekan, vachachamim omrim: patur middine adam vechayyayv bedine shamayim. vekayyma lan divnitkal poshea peligi!

Amar rabbi elazar: tivra, mi sheshshana zo lo shana zo. vaata rabbi yehuda lememar: shomer chinnam – yishshava, nose sachar – yeshallem. hay ki dineh vehay ki dineh. vaata rabbi eliezer lememar: in, gemara kerabbi meir. umihu tameah ani im yecholin ze vaze lishshava.

Bishlama shomer chinnam mishteva dela pesha ba: ella shomer sachar ammay mishteva? ki la pesha name shallome bae. vaafillu shomer chinnam name, hatinach bimkom midron. shello bimkom midron, mi matze mishteva dela pesha ba!

a: Vaafillu bimkom midron name – hatinach hecha delekka reaya, aval hecha deikka reaya – nayte reaya venippetar. detanya, isi ben yehuda omer: "en roe shevuat Adonai tihye ben shenehem", ha yesh roe – yavi reaya veyippater.
Verabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: shevua zo takkanat chachamim hi, sheim i atta omer ken – en lecha adam hammaavir chavit lachavero mimmakom lemakom.

Hechi mishteva? amar rava: shevua shello bechauona shevartiha. vaata rabbi yehuda lememar: shomer chinnam yishshava, nose sachar yeshallem, hay kedineh vehay kedineh. vaata rabbi elazar lememar: in, gemara kerabbi meir, umihu, tameah ani im yecholim ze vaze lishshava.

Bishlama shomer chinnam – mishteva shello pasha bah. ella shomer sachar, ammay mishteva? ki la pesha name bae shallome. vaafillu shomer chinnam name, ha tinach bimkom midron. shello bimkom midron, mi matze mishteva shello pasha?

Vaafillu bimkom midron name, ha tinach hecha delekka reaya, hecha deikka reaya – nayte reaya veyippater. detanya, isi ben yehuda omer: "en roe shevuat Adonai tihye ben shenehem" ha yesh roe – yavi reaya veyippater.

Hahu gavra dahava ka meabbar chavita dechamra beristeka demachoza, vetavra beziza demachoza. ata lekammeh derava. amar leh: risteka demachoza shechichi ba inashe, zil, ayyti reaya veippetar. amar leh rav yosef bereh: keman keisi? amar leh: in keisi, usevira lan kevoteh.
Hahu gavra daamar leh lechavreh: zil zeven li arba mea danne chamra. azal zevan leh. lesof ata lekammeh, amar leh: zevine lach arba mea danne chamra utekifu lehu.

Ata lekammeh derava, amar leh: arba mea danne chamra tekifi kala it la lemilleta, zil ayyti reaya demeikkara ki mezabbenat lehu chamra mealleya hava, veippetar. amar leh rav yosef bereh: keman keisi? amar leh: in keisi, usevira lan kevoteh.
Atken rav chiyyay bar yosef besichra: hane dedaru beagra veittevar – neshallem palga. may tama – nefish lechad vezutar litre, karov leones vekarov lifshia. bedigla – meshallem kulla.

Rabba bar bar chanan tevaru leh hanhu shakolae chavita dechamra, shekal liglimayyhu. ato amaru lerav. amar leh: hav lehu gelimayyhu. amar leh dina hachi? amar leh: in, "lemaan telech bederech tovim". yehayv lehu gelimayyhu. amaru leh: anye anan, vetarchinan kulle yoma, vechafenan, velet lan midde. amar leh: zil hav agrayyhu. amar leh dina hachi? amar leh: in, "veorchot tzaddikim tishmor".
Hadaran alach hassocher et haummanin

Mishna hassocher et happoalim veamar lahem lehashekim ulehaariv, makom shennahagu shello lehashekim veshello lehaariv – eno rashshay lechofan. makom shennahagu lazun – yazun, lesappek bimtika – yesappek, hakkol keminhag hammedina.
Maase berabbi yochanan ben matya sheamar livno: tze sechor lanu poalin. halach ufasak lahem mezonot.

Ucheshebba etzel aviv, amar lo: beni, afillu im atta ose lahem kisudat shelomo bishato – lo yatzata yede chovatcha immahen, shehen bene avraham yitzchak veyaakov. ella ad shello yatchilu bimlacha tze veemor lahem: al menat sheen lachem alay ella pat vekitnit bilvad. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: lo haya tzarich lomar, hakkol keminhag hammedina.

Gemara peshita! la tzericha ditfa lehu aagrayyhu. mahu detema, amar lehu: ha ditfay lechu aagrayychu addata demakdemitu umechashshechitu bahaday, ka mashma lan daamaru leh: hay ditfet lan – addata deavdinan lach avidta shappirta.
Amar resh lakish:
b: Poel bichnisato mishshello, bitziato mishshel baal habbayit, shenneemar: "tizrach hashshemesh yeasefun veel meonotam yirbatzun. yetze adam lefoolo velaavodato ade arev".
Velichze hechi nehigi – beir chadasha. venichze mehecha ka atu – benakotae. ibbaet ema: deamar lehu – deagritu li kefoel deorayyta.

Daresh rabbi zera veamri la, tane rav yosef: may dichtiv "tashet choshech vihi layla bo tirmos kol chayto yaar". "tashet choshech vihi layla" – ze haolam hazze sheddome lelayla. "bo tirmos kol chayto yaar" – ellu reshaim shebbo, sheddomin lechayya shebbayyaar.

"Tizrach hashshemesh yeasefun veel meonotam yirbatzun". "tizrach hashshemesh" – latztzaddikim, "yeasefun" – reshaim legehinnam, "veel meonotam yirbatzun" – en lach kol tzaddik vetzaddik sheen lo mador lefi chevodo. "yetze adam lefoolo" – yetzu tzaddikim lekabbel secharan, "velaavodato ade arev" – bemi shehishlim avodato ade arev.

Rabbi elazar berabbi shimon ashkach lehahu parhagvana deka tafes gannave, amar leh: hechi yachlat lehu, lav kechevata metili, dichtiv: "bo tirmos kol chayto yaar"? ikka deamri mehay kera kaamar leh: "yeerov bammistar kearye vesukko". dilma shaklat tzaddike veshavkat rashshie?
Amar leh: umay eeved? haremana demalka hu. amar: ta agmerach hechi taaved. ul bearba shae lechanuta, ki chazet inish deka shate chamra veka naket kasa bideh veka menamnem, sheol illaveh.
I tzureba merabbanan hu venayem – kaddome kaddem legirseh. i poel hu – kadem ka aved avidteh, vei avidteh belelya – raddode radded. vei la – gannava hu vetifseh.

Ishtema milleta be malka, amaru: karyayna deiggarta ihu leheve parvanka. atyu lerabbi elazar berabbi shimon, veka tafes gannave veazel. shelach leh rabbi yehoshua ben korcha chometz ben yayin! ad matay atta moser ammo shel elohenu lahariga?

Shelach leh: kotzim ani mechalle min hakkerem. shelach leh: yavo baal hakkerem vichalle et kotzav. yoma chad pega beh hahu koves, karyeh "chometz ben yayin". amar: middachatzif kulle hay – shema minna rashshia hu. amar lehu: tifsu. tafsu.

Levatar denach dateh, azal batreh lefarokeh vela matze. kare aleh: "shomer piv uleshono shomer mitztzarot nafsho". zakfu. kam tute zekifa veka vache. amaru leh: rabbi, al yera beenecha shehu uveno baalu naara meorasa beyom hakkippurim.
Hinniach yado al bene meav amar: sisu bene meay, sisu! uma sefekot shellachem kach, vaddaot shellachem – al achat kamma vechamma. muvetach ani bachem, sheen rimma vetolea sholetet bachem.
Vaafillu hachi la meyaytva dateh. ashkeyu samma deshinta veayyeylu leveta deshesha ukerau lichreseh. havo mappeki minneh dikkule dikkule detarba umotvi beshimsha betammuz veav vela masrechi.
Kol tarba name la (seriach) [masrach]! kol tarba (la seriach), [ki it be] shuryake summake masrach. hacha, af al gav deikka shuryake summake – la masrach. kare annafshe: "af besari yishkon lavetach".
Veaf rabbi yishmael berabbi yose meta

a: Ki hay maase lideh. pega beh eliyyahu,
Amar leh: ad matay atta moser ammo shel elohenu lahariga? amar leh: may eeved? haremana demalka hu! amar leh: avuch arak leasya, at arok leludekiyya.
Ki havo mikkali rabbi yishmael berabbi yose verabbi elazar berabbi shimon bahade hadade, hava ayel bakra detore benayyhu vela hava naga behu.

Amara lehu hahi matronita: benechem enam shellachem. amaru la: shellahen gadol mishshellanu. kol shekken. ikka deamri, hachi amaru la: "ki chaish gevurato". ikka deamri hachi, amaru la: "ahava docheket et habbasar".
Ulema lehu leahdore la? veha ketiv: "al taan kesil keivvalto"! shello lehotzi laaz al benehem.

Amar rabbi yochanan: evreh derabbi yishmael [berabbi yose] kechemet bat tesha kabbin. amar rav pappa: evreh derabbi yochanan kechemet bat chameshet kabbin, veamri la bat sheloshet kabbin. derav pappa gufeh ki dekure deharpenae.

Amar rabbi yochanan: ana ishtayyayri mishshappire yerushalayim hay man devae michze shufereh derabbi yochanan, nayyte kasa dechaspa mibbe silke, unemalleyeh partzidayya derummana summaka, venahdar leh kelila devavrda summaka lefummeh, venotveh ben shimsha letulla, (hahu) [hanhu] zaharure meen shufereh derabbi yochanan.

Ini? vehaamar mar: shufereh derav kahana meen shufereh derabbi avahu, shufereh derabbi avahu meen shufereh deyaakov avinu, shufereh deyaakov avinu meen shufereh deadam harishon! veillu rabbi yochanan la ka chashev leh! shane rabbi yochanan, dehadrat panim la haveya leh.
Rabbi yochanan hava azel veyatev ashshaare tevila, amar: ki salkan benot yisrael mittevilat mitzva lifgeu bi, ki hechi delehevo lehu bene shappire kevoti, gemiri orayyta kevoti.

Amaru leh rabbanan: la mistefe mar meena bisha? amar lehu: ana mizzara deyosef kaatena, dela shalta beh ena bisha. dichtiv: "ben porat yosef ben porat ale ayin", veamar rabbi avahu: al tikre "ale ayin" ella "ole ayin".
Rabbi yose bar chanina amar mehacha: "veyidgu larov bekerev haaretz", ma dagim shebbayyam mayim mechassim otam veen haayin sholetet bahen – af zaro shel yosef en haayin sholetet bahen.

Yoma chad hava ka sache rabbi yochanan beyardena. chazyeh resh lakish ushevavr leyardena abbatreh. amar leh chelach leorayyta. amar leh shuferach lenashe. amar leh i hadrat bach yahevna lach achoti, deshappira minnay. kabbel aleh. bae lemihdar leetoye maneh vela matze hadar.

Akreyeh veatneyeh veshavveyeh gavra rabba. yoma chad havo mippalgi be midresha: hassayif vehassakkin vehappigyon veharomach umaggal yad umaggal katzir meematay mekabbelin tumea – mishsheat gemar melachtan.

Umeematay gemar melachtan? rabbi yochanan omer: mishsheyyetzarfem bakkivshan. resh lakish amar: mishsheyyetzachtzechen bemayim. amar leh listaa belisteyuteh yada. amar leh: umay ahanet li? hatam "rabbi" karu li, hacha "rabbi" karu li! amar leh: ahanay lach daakarvinnach tachat kanfe hashshechina.

Chalash dateh derabbi yochanan, chalash resh lakish. atay achateh ka vachya. amara leh: ase bishvil banay! amar la: "ozva yetomecha ani achayye". ase bishvil almenuti! amar la: "vealmenotecha alay tivtachu".
Nach nafsheh derabbi shimon ben lakish, vahava ka mitztaar rabbi yochanan batreh tuva. amaru rabbanan: man lezil leyattoveh ledateh? nezil rabbi elazar ben pedat, dimchaddedayn shematateh.

Azal yetev kammeh. kol milleta dahava amar rabbi yochanan amar leh: tanya dimsayyeya lach. amar: at kevar lekisha?! bar lekisha, ki hava amena milleta, hava makshe li esrin vearba kusheyayta, umefarkina leh esrin vearbea peruke, umimmela ravvcha shemata. veat amrat: "tanya dimsayyay lach", attu la yadana deshappir kaamena?
Hava ka azel vekara maneh veka vache veamar: "hecha at bar lakisha, hecha at bar lakisha"! vahava ka tzavach ad deshaf dateh minneh. beo rabbanan rachame aleh venach nafsheh.
b: Vaafillu hachi la semach rabbi elazar berabbi shimon addateh, kabbel aleh yissure. beureta havo mayychi leh shittin namte, letzafra nagdi mittuteh shittin meshichle dema vechiva.
Limchar avada leh devethu shittin mine lafda veachel lehu uvare. vela havat shavka leh devethu lemippak leve midresha ki hechi dela lidchakuhu rabbanan.

Beureta amar lehu: achayy vereay, bou! betzafra amar lehu: zilu mippene bittul tora. yoma chad shemaa devethu, amara leh: at ka mayytet lehu illavaych! killita mamon shel bet abba. immerada, azala levet nasha.
Seliku vaato hanach [shittin] safonae, ayaylu leh shittin avde ki nekiti shittin arnake, vaavadu leh shittin mine lafda veachel lehu.

Yoma chad, amara la levarta: zili bekay baavuch may ka aved haiddana? atya, amar la: zili emari leimmich: shellanu, gadol mishshellahem. kare annafsheh: "hayta kooniyyot socher mimmerchak tavi lachmah". achal usheti uveri nefak leve midresha.

Ayyto lekammeh shittin mine dema – taharinhu. hava ka meranneni rabbanan veamri: salka datach let behu chad safek?! amar lehu: im kemoti hu – yihyu kullam zecharim, veim lav – tehe nekeva achat benehem. hayu kullam zecharim. veassiku lehu "rabbi elazar" al shemeh.
Tanya, amar rabbi: kamma periyya ureviyya bittela reshaa zo miyyisrael.

Ki hava ka naycha nafsheh, amar la lidvethu: yadana bidrabbanan dirtichi alay, vela miaski bi shappir. avgneyan beillitay vela tidchalin minnay. amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani: ishtaya li immeh derabbi yonatan, deishtaya la devethu derabbi elazar berabbi shimon: la pachot mittamne sere, vela tefe meesrin uteren shenin avgneteh beillita.

Ki hava salykana meayyenana leh bemazyeh, ki hava mishtamta binita minneh hava ate dema. yoma chad chazay richsha deka nafek meunneh, chalash datay. itchazi li bechelma amar li: la midde hu, yoma chad shami beziluta detzureba merabbanan vela machay kidvae li.

Ki havo atu be tere ledina, havo kayymi abbava, amar mar milleteh umar milleteh nafek kala meilliteh, veamar: ish peloni atta chayyayv, ish peloni atta zakkay. yoma chad hava ka minnatzya devethu bahade shivavta, amara la: tehe kevaala shello nittan likvura. amri rabbanan: kulle hay vadday lav orach ara.

Ikka deamri, rabbi shimon ben yochay itchazay lehu bechelma, amar lehu: pereda achat yesh li benechem, vei attem rotzim lahaviah etzli? azul rabbanan leiasoke beh, la shevaku bene achberayya, dechol shene dahava nayem rabbi elazar berabbi shimon beilliteh la selik chayya raa lematayyhu.

Yoma chad maale yoma dechippure hava, havo teridi. shaddaru rabbanan livne vere veassekuhu learseh veamteyu limarta daavu. ashkechuha leachna dehadra la limarta. amaru la: achna achna! pitchi pich veyikkanes ben etzel aviv. petacha[5] lehu.

Shalach rabbi ledabber beishto, shelacha leh: keli shennishtammesh bo kodesh yishtammesh bo chol? tamman amrin: baatar demare veta tela zeyayneh, kuleba raaya kulleteh tela. shelach la: nehi divtora gadol mimmenni, aval bemaasim tovim mi gadol mimmenni? shelacha leh: betora miha gadol mimmecha la yadana, bemaasim yadana, deha kabbel aleh yissure.
Betora may hi? dechi havo yatvi rabban shimon ben gamliel verabbi yehoshua ben korcha assafsalle, yatvi kammayyhu rabbi elazar berabbi shimon verabbi aara.
Makshu umefarku. amri: mimehen anu shotim vehem yoshvim al gabbe karka?! avadu lehu safsalle assekinhu.

Amar lahen rabban shimon ben gamliel: pereda achat yesh li benechem, veattem mevakkeshim leabbedah hemeni? achatu lerabbi. amar lahen rabbi yehoshua ben korcha: mi sheyyesh lo av yichye, umi sheen lo av yamut? achatu name lerabbi elazar berabbi shimon. chalash dateh, amar: ka chashvitu leh kevoti?

Ad hahu yoma ki hava amar rabbi milleta hava mesayyay leh rabbi elazar berabbi shimon: mikkan veelach ki hava amar rabbi "yesh li lehashiv", amar leh rabbi elazar berabbi shimon: kach vechach yesh lecha lehashiv, zo hi teshuvatcha. hasheta hikkaftanu teshuvot chavilot sheen bahen mammash.
Chalash dateh derabbi. ata amar leh laavu. amar leh: bene, al yera lach, shehu ari ben ari veatta ari ben shual.
Hayeynu deamar rabbi: shelosha invevtanin hen, veellu hen: abba,
